from collections.abc import Callable
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, TimeoutError as FuturesTimeoutError
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
import ipaddress
import logging
import time

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import settings
from app.engines.discovery.discovery_progress import NMAP_MAX_PERCENT, inventory_percent
from app.engines.discovery.dns_resolver import iter_host_addresses, reverse_dns
from app.engines.discovery.ip_intel import lookup_ip_intel
from app.engines.discovery.oui import lookup_vendor
from app.engines.discovery.nmap_scanner import NmapHost, ScanCancelledError, ScanTimeoutError
from app.engines.discovery.scan_options import ResolvedScanOptions, resolve_scan_options
from app.engines.discovery.snmp_collector import SnmpDeviceInfo, collect_snmp_info, infer_device_type
from app.engines.discovery.software_collector import collect_device_software
from app.engines.discovery.ssh_collector import collect_ssh_info, ssh_credentials_configured
from app.engines.discovery.wmi_collector import collect_wmi_info, wmi_credentials_configured
from app.models import Device, DeviceHistory, DeviceStatus, Event, EventSeverity, Monitor, MonitorType

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


TRACKED_FIELDS = (
    "hostname",
    "mac_address",
    "vendor",
    "model",
    "os_name",
    "device_type",
    "status",
)


@dataclass
class DiscoveredHost:
    ip_address: str
    hostname: str | None = None
    mac_address: str | None = None
    vendor: str | None = None
    model: str | None = None
    os_name: str | None = None
    device_type: str | None = None
    snmp_info: SnmpDeviceInfo | None = None
    extra_data: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass
class InventoryResult:
    devices_found: int = 0
    devices_new: int = 0
    devices_updated: int = 0
    devices_inactive: int = 0
    subnet_ips_total: int = 0


def _serialize_value(value) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, DeviceStatus):
        return value.value
    return str(value)


def record_device_change_sync(
    session: Session,
    device_id: int,
    field_name: str,
    old_value: str | None,
    new_value: str | None,
) -> None:
    if old_value == new_value:
        return
    session.add(
        DeviceHistory(
            device_id=device_id,
            field_name=field_name,
            old_value=old_value,
            new_value=new_value,
        )
    )


def apply_field_update_sync(session: Session, device: Device, field_name: str, new_value) -> bool:
    old_value = getattr(device, field_name)
    old_str = _serialize_value(old_value)
    new_str = _serialize_value(new_value)
    if old_str == new_str:
        return False
    setattr(device, field_name, new_value)
    record_device_change_sync(session, device.id, field_name, old_str, new_str)
    return True


def merge_extra_data(existing: dict | None, updates: dict) -> dict:
    """Merge raso no topo; dicts aninhados (snmp/wmi/nmap/zion) são mesclados sem apagar irmãos."""
    merged = dict(existing or {})
    for key, value in (updates or {}).items():
        if isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(merged.get(key), dict):
            nested = dict(merged[key])
            nested.update(value)
            merged[key] = nested
        else:
            merged[key] = value
    return merged


def apply_nmap_to_host(host: DiscoveredHost, nmap_host: NmapHost) -> None:
    host.hostname = host.hostname or nmap_host.hostname
    host.mac_address = host.mac_address or nmap_host.mac_address
    host.vendor = host.vendor or nmap_host.vendor
    host.os_name = host.os_name or nmap_host.os_name
    if nmap_host.open_ports:
        host.extra_data = merge_extra_data(
            host.extra_data,
            {"nmap": {"open_ports": nmap_host.open_ports, "os": nmap_host.os_name}},
        )
    if nmap_host.os_name and not host.device_type:
        host.device_type = infer_device_type(nmap_host.os_name)


def build_discovered_host(
    ip_address: str,
    use_snmp: bool,
    snmp_community: str | None,
    *,
    fast_mode: bool = False,
    use_wmi: bool = False,
    use_ssh: bool = False,
    collect_software: bool = False,
) -> DiscoveredHost:
    if fast_mode:
        return DiscoveredHost(ip_address=ip_address)

    host = DiscoveredHost(ip_address=ip_address, hostname=reverse_dns(ip_address, timeout=2.0))

    sources: list[str] = []

    intel = lookup_ip_intel(ip_address)
    if intel.get("hostname") and not host.hostname:
        host.hostname = intel["hostname"]
        sources.append("ptr")
    if intel.get("vendor"):
        host.vendor = intel["vendor"]
        sources.append("rdap")
    if intel.get("model"):
        host.model = intel["model"]

    if use_snmp:
        snmp_info = collect_snmp_info(ip_address, snmp_community)
        host.snmp_info = snmp_info
        if snmp_info.reachable:
            host.hostname = snmp_info.sys_name or host.hostname
            host.os_name = snmp_info.sys_descr
            host.vendor = snmp_info.vendor or host.vendor
            host.model = snmp_info.model or host.model
            host.mac_address = snmp_info.mac_address
            if host.mac_address and not host.vendor:
                host.vendor = lookup_vendor(host.mac_address)
            host.device_type = infer_device_type(snmp_info.sys_descr)
            sources = ["snmp", *[s for s in sources if s != "snmp"]]
            host.extra_data = {
                "snmp": {
                    "sys_location": snmp_info.sys_location,
                    "sys_uptime": snmp_info.sys_uptime,
                    "interface_count": snmp_info.interface_count,
                    "cpu_load": snmp_info.cpu_load,
                    "cpu_loads": snmp_info.cpu_loads,
                    "memory_used_pct": snmp_info.memory_used_pct,
                    "memory_total_kb": snmp_info.memory_total_kb,
                    "memory_used_kb": snmp_info.memory_used_kb,
                    "disk_used_pct": snmp_info.disk_used_pct,
                    "disks": snmp_info.disks,
                    "temperature_c": snmp_info.temperature_c,
                    "temperatures": snmp_info.temperatures,
                    "interfaces": snmp_info.interfaces,
                },
            }

    if use_wmi:
        wmi_info = collect_wmi_info(ip_address)
        host.extra_data = merge_extra_data(
            host.extra_data,
            {
                "wmi": {
                    "reachable": wmi_info.reachable,
                    "port_open": wmi_info.port_open,
                    "domain": wmi_info.domain,
                    "serial_number": wmi_info.serial_number,
                    "os_version": wmi_info.os_version,
                    "logged_user": wmi_info.logged_user,
                    "full_name": wmi_info.full_name,
                    "dns_servers": wmi_info.dns_servers,
                    "gateway": wmi_info.gateway,
                    "ou": wmi_info.ou,
                    "department": wmi_info.department,
                    "memory_total_mb": wmi_info.memory_total_mb,
                    "disk_free_pct": wmi_info.disk_free_pct,
                    "temperature_c": wmi_info.temperature_c,
                    "error": wmi_info.error,
                    **(wmi_info.extra or {}),
                },
                "zion": {
                    **((host.extra_data or {}).get("zion") or {}),
                    "full_name_ad": wmi_info.full_name,
                    "logged_user": wmi_info.logged_user,
                    "ou": wmi_info.ou,
                    "department": wmi_info.department,
                    "gateway": wmi_info.gateway,
                    "dns": wmi_info.dns_servers,
                    "domain": wmi_info.domain,
                },
            },
        )
        if wmi_info.reachable:
            host.hostname = wmi_info.hostname or host.hostname
            host.os_name = wmi_info.os_name or host.os_name
            host.vendor = wmi_info.vendor or host.vendor
            host.model = wmi_info.model or host.model
            if not host.device_type:
                host.device_type = "server"
            if "wmi" not in sources:
                sources.append("wmi")
            if wmi_info.full_name or wmi_info.ou:
                sources.append("ad")

    if use_ssh:
        ssh_info = collect_ssh_info(ip_address)
        host.extra_data = merge_extra_data(
            host.extra_data,
            {
                "ssh": {
                    "reachable": ssh_info.reachable,
                    "port_open": ssh_info.port_open,
                    "error": ssh_info.error,
                },
            },
        )
        if ssh_info.reachable:
            host.hostname = ssh_info.hostname or host.hostname
            host.os_name = ssh_info.os_name or host.os_name
            host.vendor = ssh_info.vendor or host.vendor
            host.model = ssh_info.model or host.model
            host.device_type = ssh_info.device_type or host.device_type
            if "ssh" not in sources:
                sources.append("ssh")

    if collect_software:
        sw = collect_device_software(
            ip_address,
            use_snmp=use_snmp,
            use_wmi=use_wmi and wmi_credentials_configured(),
            snmp_community=snmp_community,
            include_slow_wmi=False,
        )
        if sw.packages or sw.sources or sw.error:
            host.extra_data = merge_extra_data(host.extra_data, sw.to_extra_data())

    if sources:
        host.extra_data = merge_extra_data(host.extra_data, {"enrichment": {"sources": sources}})

    return host


def _build_discovered_host_timed(
    ip_address: str,
    use_snmp: bool,
    snmp_community: str | None,
    *,
    fast_mode: bool,
    timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    use_wmi: bool = False,
    use_ssh: bool = False,
    collect_software: bool = False,
) -> DiscoveredHost:
    if fast_mode:
        return DiscoveredHost(ip_address=ip_address)

    timeout = timeout_seconds if timeout_seconds is not None else settings.discovery_host_enrich_timeout_seconds
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
        future = pool.submit(
            build_discovered_host,
            ip_address,
            use_snmp,
            snmp_community,
            fast_mode=fast_mode,
            use_wmi=use_wmi,
            use_ssh=use_ssh,
            collect_software=collect_software,
        )
        try:
            return future.result(timeout=timeout)
        except FuturesTimeoutError:
            logger.warning("Timeout ao enriquecer host %s (>%ss)", ip_address, timeout)
            return DiscoveredHost(ip_address=ip_address)

"""Operações de jobs de discovery (limite de histórico, cancelamento)."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import delete, func, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import settings
from app.models import DiscoveryJob, DiscoveryJobStatus

MAX_DISCOVERY_JOBS = 3


def cycle_discovery_job_ids_if_needed(session: Session) -> bool:
    """Reinicia a numeração dos jobs (1…max) quando o último ID atinge o limite."""
    max_id = session.execute(select(func.max(DiscoveryJob.id))).scalar() or 0
    if max_id < settings.discovery_jobs_max_id:
        return False

    session.execute(delete(DiscoveryJob))
    session.execute(text("ALTER SEQUENCE discovery_jobs_id_seq RESTART WITH 1"))
    return True


def prune_discovery_jobs(session: Session, keep: int = MAX_DISCOVERY_JOBS) -> int:
    """Mantém apenas os `keep` jobs mais recentes; remove os mais antigos."""
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).order_by(DiscoveryJob.created_at.desc(), DiscoveryJob.id.desc())
    ).scalars().all()
    removed = 0
    for old in jobs[keep:]:
        if old.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING, DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING):
            stop_discovery_job(session, old)
        session.delete(old)
        removed += 1
    return removed


def stop_discovery_job(session: Session, job: DiscoveryJob) -> DiscoveryJob:
    """Solicita parada do scan e revoga a task Celery associada."""
    if job.status in (DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED, DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED):
        return job

    job.cancel_requested = True

    if job.celery_task_id:
        from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app

        celery_app.control.revoke(job.celery_task_id, terminate=True, signal="SIGKILL")

    job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
    job.error_message = "Scan cancelado pelo usuário"
    job.progress_label = "Scan cancelado"
    job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    session.add(job)
    return job


def is_job_cancelled(session: Session, job_id: int) -> bool:
    job = session.get(DiscoveryJob, job_id)
    if not job:
        return True
    return bool(job.cancel_requested) or job.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED


def has_active_discovery_job(session: Session) -> bool:
    job = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob.id)
        .where(DiscoveryJob.status.in_((DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING, DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING)))
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    return job is not None


def reconcile_cancelled_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Garante que jobs com cancel_requested não permaneçam como RUNNING."""
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(
            DiscoveryJob.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING,
            DiscoveryJob.cancel_requested.is_(True),
        )
    ).scalars().all()

    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    fixed = 0
    for job in jobs:
        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
        job.error_message = job.error_message or "Scan cancelado pelo usuário"
        job.progress_label = "Scan cancelado"
        job.completed_at = job.completed_at or now
        fixed += 1
    return fixed


def fail_stale_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Marca como falha jobs RUNNING/PENDING parados além do tempo máximo."""
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(seconds=settings.discovery_job_stale_seconds)
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(
            DiscoveryJob.status.in_((DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING, DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING)),
            DiscoveryJob.started_at.is_not(None),
            DiscoveryJob.started_at < cutoff,
        )
    ).scalars().all()

    failed = 0
    for job in jobs:
        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
        job.error_message = f"Scan expirou após {settings.discovery_job_stale_seconds // 60} min sem concluir"
        job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
        job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        failed += 1
    return failed


def fail_stuck_pending_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Marca como falha jobs PENDING que nunca foram iniciados pelo worker."""
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(seconds=90)
    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(
            DiscoveryJob.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.PENDING,
            DiscoveryJob.started_at.is_(None),
            DiscoveryJob.created_at < cutoff,
        )
    ).scalars().all()

    failed = 0
    for job in jobs:
        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
        job.error_message = "Scan não iniciou — worker indisponível ou fila cheia"
        job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
        job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        failed += 1
    return failed


def fail_orphaned_discovery_jobs(session: Session) -> int:
    """Marca como falha jobs RUNNING cuja task Celery não está mais ativa."""
    from celery.result import AsyncResult

    from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app

    jobs = session.execute(
        select(DiscoveryJob).where(DiscoveryJob.status == DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING)
    ).scalars().all()
    if not jobs:
        return 0

    active_ids: set[str] = set()
    inspect = celery_app.control.inspect(timeout=2.0)
    if inspect:
        for bucket in (inspect.active() or {}, inspect.reserved() or {}, inspect.scheduled() or {}):
            for task_list in bucket.values():
                for task in task_list or []:
                    task_id = task.get("id")
                    if task_id:
                        active_ids.add(task_id)

    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    min_age = timedelta(seconds=30)
    orphan_age = timedelta(seconds=45)
    failed = 0

    for job in jobs:
        if not job.started_at or (now - job.started_at) < min_age:
            continue

        if not job.celery_task_id:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Scan perdido (sem task Celery associada)"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1
            continue

        if job.celery_task_id in active_ids:
            continue

        result = AsyncResult(job.celery_task_id, app=celery_app)
        state = result.state
        if state in ("SUCCESS", "FAILURE", "REVOKED"):
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            if state == "FAILURE" and result.result:
                job.error_message = str(result.result)[:500]
            else:
                job.error_message = "Scan interrompido antes de concluir"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1
        elif state == "PENDING" and (now - job.started_at) >= min_age:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Scan interrompido (worker offline ou task perdida)"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1
        elif (now - job.started_at) >= orphan_age:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Scan interrompido (sem resposta do worker)"
            job.progress_label = "Scan falhou"
            job.completed_at = now
            failed += 1

    return failed

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, HTTPException, UploadFile, status

from app.database import get_db
from app.dependencies import require_admin, require_operator, require_viewer
from app.models import Device, DeviceHistory, DeviceStatus, Event, EventSeverity, Metric, TopologyLayout, User

    DeviceCreate,

    DeviceImportResult,

)

)

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("", response_model=list[DeviceResponse])
async def list_devices(
    include_retired: bool = False,
    on_map: bool = False,
    limit: int = 2500,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    query = select(Device).order_by(Device.ip_address)
    if not include_retired:
        query = query.where(Device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED)
    if on_map:
        query = query.join(TopologyLayout, TopologyLayout.device_id == Device.id)
    query = query.limit(min(max(limit, 1), 2500))
    result = await db.execute(query)
    return result.scalars().all()


@router.post("", response_model=DeviceResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_device(
    payload: DeviceCreate,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    existing = await get_device_by_ip(db, payload.ip_address)
    if existing:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, detail="IP já cadastrado")

    device = await create_device_with_monitor(
        db,
        ip_address=payload.ip_address,
        hostname=payload.hostname,
        mac_address=payload.mac_address,
        vendor=payload.vendor,
        model=payload.model,
        os_name=payload.os_name,
        device_type=payload.device_type,
        extra_data=payload.extra_data,
    )
    return device


@router.get("/{device_id}", response_model=DeviceResponse)
async def get_device(
    device_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    device = await db.get(Device, device_id)
    if not device:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Dispositivo não encontrado")
    return device


@router.post("/{device_id}/enrich", response_model=DeviceResponse)
async def enrich_device(
    device_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    device = await db.get(Device, device_id)
    if not device:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Dispositivo não encontrado")

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.inventory_service import enrich_device_from_network

    with SyncSession() as session:
        sync_device = session.get(Device, device_id)
        if not sync_device:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Dispositivo não encontrado")
        enrich_device_from_network(session, sync_device)
        session.commit()

    await db.refresh(device)
    return device

    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),

):
    device = await db.get(Device, device_id)
    if not device:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Dispositivo não encontrado")
    from app.services.hardware_service import build_hardware_inventory

    return DeviceHardwareResponse(**build_hardware_inventory(device))


@router.get("/{device_id}/software", response_model=DeviceSoftwareResponse)
async def get_device_software(
    device_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_viewer),
):
    device = await db.get(Device, device_id)
    if not device:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Dispositivo não encontrado")
    from app.services.inventory_service import software_from_device

    return DeviceSoftwareResponse(**software_from_device(device))


@router.post("/{device_id}/software/refresh", response_model=DeviceSoftwareResponse)
async def refresh_device_software_route(
    device_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),

):

):

    extra_data = update_data.pop("extra_data", None)
    if extra_data is not None:
        old_str = str(device.extra_data)
        device.extra_data = extra_data
        from app.services.device_service import record_device_change

        await record_device_change(db, device, "extra_data", old_str, str(extra_data))

    for field, value in update_data.items():
        await update_device_field(db, device, field, value)

    return device

async def retire_device(
    device_id: int,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    device = await db.get(Device, device_id)
    if not device:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Dispositivo não encontrado")

    await update_device_field(db, device, "status", DeviceStatus.RETIRED)
    layout = await db.get(TopologyLayout, device_id)
    if layout:
        await db.delete(layout)
    db.add(
        Event(
            device_id=device.id,
            event_type="device_retired",
            message=f"Dispositivo {device.ip_address} removido do mapa",
            severity=EventSeverity.INFO,
        )
    )

):

        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail="Arquivo deve ser CSV")

    content = (await file.read()).decode("utf-8")
    imported, skipped, errors = await import_devices_from_csv(db, content)
    return DeviceImportResult(imported=imported, skipped=skipped, errors=errors)

import csv
import io
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models import Device, DeviceHistory, DeviceStatus, Monitor, MonitorType


async def record_device_change(
    db: AsyncSession,
    device: Device,
    field_name: str,
    old_value: str | None,
    new_value: str | None,
) -> None:
    if old_value == new_value:
        return
    db.add(
        DeviceHistory(
            device_id=device.id,
            field_name=field_name,
            old_value=old_value,
            new_value=new_value,
        )
    )


async def update_device_field(
    db: AsyncSession,
    device: Device,
    field_name: str,
    new_value: str | None,
) -> None:
    old_value = getattr(device, field_name, None)
    if isinstance(old_value, DeviceStatus):
        old_value = old_value.value
    old_str = str(old_value) if old_value is not None else None
    new_str = str(new_value) if new_value is not None else None

    if old_str == new_str:
        return

    setattr(device, field_name, new_value)
    await record_device_change(db, device, field_name, old_str, new_str)


async def get_device_by_ip(db: AsyncSession, ip_address: str) -> Device | None:
    result = await db.execute(select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == ip_address))
    return result.scalar_one_or_none()


async def create_device_with_monitor(db: AsyncSession, ip_address: str, **kwargs) -> Device:
    device = Device(ip_address=ip_address, status=DeviceStatus.UNKNOWN, **kwargs)
    db.add(device)
    await db.flush()

    monitor = Monitor(
        device_id=device.id,
        monitor_type=MonitorType.PING,
        target=ip_address,
        interval_seconds=60,
        is_enabled=True,
    )
    db.add(monitor)
    await db.flush()
    return device


def create_device_with_monitor_sync(session, ip_address: str, **kwargs) -> Device:
    device = Device(ip_address=ip_address, status=DeviceStatus.UNKNOWN, **kwargs)
    session.add(device)
    session.flush()
    session.add(
        Monitor(
            device_id=device.id,
            monitor_type=MonitorType.PING,
            target=ip_address,
            interval_seconds=60,
            is_enabled=True,
        )
    )
    session.flush()
    return device


async def import_devices_from_csv(db: AsyncSession, content: str) -> tuple[int, int, list[str]]:
    reader = csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(content))
    imported = 0
    skipped = 0
    errors: list[str] = []

    if not reader.fieldnames or "ip_address" not in reader.fieldnames:
        return 0, 0, ["CSV deve conter coluna 'ip_address'"]

    for row_num, row in enumerate(reader, start=2):
        ip = (row.get("ip_address") or "").strip()
        if not ip:
            errors.append(f"Linha {row_num}: IP vazio")
            continue

        existing = await get_device_by_ip(db, ip)
        if existing:
            skipped += 1
            continue

        try:
            await create_device_with_monitor(
                db,
                ip_address=ip,
                hostname=(row.get("hostname") or "").strip() or None,
                device_type=(row.get("device_type") or "").strip() or None,
            )
            imported += 1
        except Exception as exc:
            errors.append(f"Linha {row_num}: {exc}")

    return imported, skipped, errors

"""Agregação de inventário de hardware a partir de Device + extra_data."""

from __future__ import annotations

from app.models import Device


def _pick(*vals):
    for val in vals:
        if val is not None and val != "":
            return val
    return None


def build_hardware_inventory(device: Device) -> dict:
    extra = device.extra_data or {}
    snmp = extra.get("snmp") or {}
    wmi = extra.get("wmi") or {}
    nmap_block = extra.get("nmap") or {}
    nmap = nmap_block.get("open_ports") or []
    ssh = extra.get("ssh") or {}
    protocols = extra.get("protocols") or {}
    ups = snmp.get("ups") if isinstance(snmp.get("ups"), dict) else {}

    open_ports = []
    for entry in nmap:
        if isinstance(entry, dict):
            open_ports.append(
                {
                    "port": entry.get("port"),
                    "service": entry.get("service"),
                    "protocol": entry.get("protocol") or "tcp",
                }
            )
        elif isinstance(entry, (int, str)):
            open_ports.append({"port": entry, "service": None, "protocol": "tcp"})

    disks = snmp.get("disks") or wmi.get("disks") or []
    if not isinstance(disks, list):
        disks = []

    interfaces = snmp.get("interfaces") or []
    if not isinstance(interfaces, list):
        interfaces = []
    ifaces_up = sum(1 for i in interfaces if isinstance(i, dict) and str(i.get("status") or "").lower() == "up")

    return {
        "device_id": device.id,
        "ip_address": device.ip_address,
        "hostname": device.hostname or wmi.get("hostname") or snmp.get("sys_name"),
        "mac_address": device.mac_address,
        "vendor": device.vendor or wmi.get("vendor") or snmp.get("vendor"),
        "model": device.model or wmi.get("model") or snmp.get("model"),
        "os_name": _pick(
            device.os_name,
            wmi.get("os_name"),
            snmp.get("sys_descr"),
            nmap_block.get("os"),
        ),
        "device_type": device.device_type,
        "serial_number": wmi.get("serial_number") or extra.get("serial_number"),
        "firmware_version": extra.get("firmware_version") or snmp.get("firmware_version"),
        "sys_location": snmp.get("sys_location"),
        "sys_uptime": snmp.get("sys_uptime")
        or (f"{int(float(wmi['uptime_seconds']))}s" if wmi.get("uptime_seconds") is not None else None),
        "interface_count": snmp.get("interface_count") or len(interfaces) or None,
        "interfaces_up": ifaces_up,
        "cpu_load": _pick(snmp.get("cpu_load"), wmi.get("cpu_load")),
        "memory_used_pct": _pick(snmp.get("memory_used_pct"), wmi.get("memory_used_pct")),
        "memory_total_kb": snmp.get("memory_total_kb")
        or (round(float(wmi["memory_total_mb"]) * 1024, 2) if wmi.get("memory_total_mb") else None),
        "disk_used_pct": _pick(snmp.get("disk_used_pct"), wmi.get("disk_used_pct")),
        "disks": disks,
        "temperature_c": _pick(snmp.get("temperature_c"), wmi.get("temperature_c")),
        "interfaces": interfaces,
        "open_ports": open_ports,
        "ups_status": _pick(ups.get("status"), snmp.get("ups_status")),
        "ups_battery_charge": _pick(ups.get("battery_charge"), snmp.get("ups_battery_charge")),
        "ups_load_pct": _pick(ups.get("load_pct"), snmp.get("ups_load_pct")),
        "ups_on_battery": _pick(ups.get("on_battery"), snmp.get("ups_on_battery")),
        "ssh_reachable": ssh.get("reachable"),
        "wmi_reachable": wmi.get("reachable"),
        "logged_user": wmi.get("logged_user"),
        "full_name_ad": wmi.get("full_name"),
        "domain": wmi.get("domain"),
        "ou": wmi.get("ou"),
        "department": wmi.get("department"),
        "gateway": wmi.get("gateway"),
        "dns": wmi.get("dns_servers"),
        "protocols": protocols,
        "sources": (extra.get("enrichment") or {}).get("sources") or [],
    }

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from sqlalchemy import func, select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import Device, Metric, Monitor, MonitorType


def monitor_due(session: Session, monitor: Monitor) -> bool:
    latest = session.execute(
        select(Metric.recorded_at)
        .where(Metric.monitor_id == monitor.id)
        .order_by(Metric.recorded_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if latest is None:
        return True
    if latest.tzinfo is None:
        latest = latest.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
    return datetime.now(UTC) - latest >= timedelta(seconds=monitor.interval_seconds)


def run_monitor_check(session: Session, monitor: Monitor) -> bool:
    import asyncio

    from app.engines.monitor.http_check import check_http, check_https
    from app.engines.monitor.ping import ping_host
    from app.engines.monitor.tcp_check import check_tcp
    from app.models import DeviceStatus, Event, EventSeverity
    from app.services.alert_service import queue_alerts_for_event

    if not monitor_due(session, monitor):
        return False

    device = session.get(Device, monitor.device_id)
    if not device:
        return False

    target = monitor.target or device.ip_address
    metrics_to_add: list[Metric] = []

    if monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.PING:
        is_alive, latency = asyncio.run(ping_host(target))
        metrics_to_add.append(
            Metric(
                device_id=device.id,
                monitor_id=monitor.id,
                metric_name="latency_ms" if is_alive else "packet_loss",
                value=latency if is_alive and latency is not None else 100.0,
                unit="ms" if is_alive else "percent",
            )
        )
        previous_status = device.status
        new_status = DeviceStatus.ACTIVE if is_alive else DeviceStatus.INACTIVE
        if previous_status != new_status:
            if new_status == DeviceStatus.INACTIVE:
                event = Event(
                    device_id=device.id,
                    event_type="device_down",
                    message=f"Dispositivo {device.ip_address} ({device.hostname or 'sem hostname'}) está offline",
                    severity=EventSeverity.CRITICAL,
                )
                session.add(event)
                session.flush()
                # Alarme padrão + alarme Zion se o host estiver em painel (ou watch_offline)
                from app.services.zion_panels import device_in_zion_panels, raise_zion_offline_alarm

                zion_watch = bool((device.extra_data or {}).get("zion", {}).get("watch_offline"))
                if zion_watch or device_in_zion_panels(session, device.id):
                    raise_zion_offline_alarm(session, device, event)
                else:
                    queue_alerts_for_event(session, event)
            elif previous_status == DeviceStatus.INACTIVE:
                event = Event(
                    device_id=device.id,
                    event_type="device_up",
                    message=f"Dispositivo {device.ip_address} voltou online",
                    severity=EventSeverity.INFO,
                )
                session.add(event)
                session.flush()
                queue_alerts_for_event(session, event)
            from app.services.realtime_events import event_bus

            event_bus.publish(
                "device_status_changed",
                {
                    "device_id": device.id,
                    "ip_address": device.ip_address,
                    "previous_status": previous_status.value,
                    "new_status": new_status.value,
                },
            )
        device.status = new_status
        device.last_seen = datetime.now(UTC) if is_alive else device.last_seen
        session.add(device)

    elif monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.HTTP:
        ok, elapsed, status_code = asyncio.run(check_http(target))
        metrics_to_add.extend([
            Metric(device_id=device.id, monitor_id=monitor.id, metric_name="response_time_ms", value=elapsed, unit="ms"),
            Metric(
                device_id=device.id,
                monitor_id=monitor.id,
                metric_name="http_up",
                value=1.0 if ok else 0.0,
                unit="bool",
            ),
        ])
        if status_code is not None:
            metrics_to_add.append(
                Metric(device_id=device.id, monitor_id=monitor.id, metric_name="http_status", value=float(status_code), unit="code")
            )
        if not ok:
            _maybe_http_down_event(session, device, target)

    elif monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.HTTPS:
        ok, elapsed, status_code = asyncio.run(check_https(target))
        metrics_to_add.extend([
            Metric(device_id=device.id, monitor_id=monitor.id, metric_name="response_time_ms", value=elapsed, unit="ms"),
            Metric(device_id=device.id, monitor_id=monitor.id, metric_name="https_up", value=1.0 if ok else 0.0, unit="bool"),
        ])
        if status_code is not None:
            metrics_to_add.append(
                Metric(device_id=device.id, monitor_id=monitor.id, metric_name="http_status", value=float(status_code), unit="code")
            )
        if not ok:
            _maybe_http_down_event(session, device, target)

    elif monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.TCP:
        ok, elapsed = asyncio.run(check_tcp(target))
        metrics_to_add.extend([
            Metric(device_id=device.id, monitor_id=monitor.id, metric_name="connect_time_ms", value=elapsed, unit="ms"),
            Metric(device_id=device.id, monitor_id=monitor.id, metric_name="tcp_up", value=1.0 if ok else 0.0, unit="bool"),
        ])
        if not ok:
            _maybe_tcp_down_event(session, device, target)

    for metric in metrics_to_add:
        session.add(metric)
    return True


def _maybe_http_down_event(session: Session, device: Device, target: str) -> None:
    from app.models import Event, EventSeverity
    from app.services.alert_service import queue_alerts_for_event

    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=5)
    recent = session.execute(
        select(Event).where(
            Event.device_id == device.id,
            Event.event_type == "http_check_failed",
            Event.created_at >= cutoff,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if recent:
        return
    event = Event(
        device_id=device.id,
        event_type="http_check_failed",
        message=f"HTTP/HTTPS falhou em {target}",
        severity=EventSeverity.WARNING,
    )
    session.add(event)
    session.flush()
    queue_alerts_for_event(session, event)


def _maybe_tcp_down_event(session: Session, device: Device, target: str) -> None:
    from app.models import Event, EventSeverity
    from app.services.alert_service import queue_alerts_for_event

    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(minutes=5)
    recent = session.execute(
        select(Event).where(
            Event.device_id == device.id,
            Event.event_type == "tcp_check_failed",
            Event.created_at >= cutoff,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if recent:
        return
    event = Event(
        device_id=device.id,
        event_type="tcp_check_failed",
        message=f"Porta TCP inacessível: {target}",
        severity=EventSeverity.WARNING,
    )
    session.add(event)
    session.flush()
    queue_alerts_for_event(session, event)


def compute_device_sla(session: Session, device_id: int, days: int = 7) -> dict:
    since = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=days)
    ping_metrics = session.execute(
        select(Metric)
        .where(
            Metric.device_id == device_id,
            Metric.metric_name.in_(["latency_ms", "packet_loss"]),
            Metric.recorded_at >= since,
        )
        .order_by(Metric.recorded_at.asc())
    ).scalars().all()

    if not ping_metrics:
        return {"days": days, "uptime_percent": None, "samples": 0, "avg_latency_ms": None}

    up_samples = sum(1 for m in ping_metrics if m.metric_name == "latency_ms")
    uptime = round(up_samples / len(ping_metrics) * 100, 2)

    latencies = [m.value for m in ping_metrics if m.metric_name == "latency_ms"]
    avg_latency = round(sum(latencies) / len(latencies), 2) if latencies else None

    return {
        "days": days,
        "uptime_percent": uptime,
        "samples": len(ping_metrics),
        "avg_latency_ms": avg_latency,
    }


def cleanup_old_metrics(session: Session, retention_days: int = 90) -> int:
    from sqlalchemy import delete

    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=retention_days)
    result = session.execute(delete(Metric).where(Metric.recorded_at < cutoff))
    return result.rowcount or 0

import asyncio
import time

import httpx


async def check_http(url: str, timeout: int = 5, verify_ssl: bool = True) -> tuple[bool, float, int | None]:
    if not url.startswith(("http://", "https://")):
        url = f"http://{url}"
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=timeout, verify=verify_ssl, follow_redirects=True) as client:
            response = await client.get(url)
            elapsed = round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, 2)
            return response.status_code < 400, elapsed, response.status_code
    except Exception:
        return False, round((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000, 2), None


async def check_https(url: str, timeout: int = 5) -> tuple[bool, float, int | None]:
    if not url.startswith("https://"):
        url = f"https://{url.lstrip('http://')}"
    return await check_http(url, timeout=timeout, verify_ssl=True)

"""Coletores de protocolos adicionais (WinRM, Modbus, MQTT, IPMI, Telnet, NTP)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import logging
import socket
import struct
import time

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class ProtocolProbeResult:
    protocol: str
    reachable: bool = False
    latency_ms: float | None = None
    detail: str | None = None
    metrics: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    error: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "protocol": self.protocol,
            "reachable": self.reachable,
            "latency_ms": self.latency_ms,
            "detail": self.detail,
            "metrics": self.metrics,
            "error": self.error,
        }


def _tcp_probe(host: str, port: int, timeout: float = 3.0, banner: bool = False) -> ProtocolProbeResult:
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=timeout) as sock:
            latency = (time.monotonic() - started) * 1000
            detail = None
            if banner:
                sock.settimeout(min(timeout, 2.0))
                try:
                    data = sock.recv(256)
                    detail = data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").strip()[:200] or None
                except OSError:
                    detail = None
            return ProtocolProbeResult(
                protocol=f"tcp/{port}",
                reachable=True,
                latency_ms=round(latency, 2),
                detail=detail,
            )
    except OSError as exc:
        return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol=f"tcp/{port}", reachable=False, error=str(exc)[:120])


def probe_telnet(host: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> ProtocolProbeResult:
    timeout = timeout or settings.protocol_probe_timeout_seconds
    result = _tcp_probe(host, 23, timeout=timeout, banner=True)
    result.protocol = "telnet"
    return result


def probe_ntp(host: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> ProtocolProbeResult:
    timeout = timeout or settings.protocol_probe_timeout_seconds
    # NTP client mode request (LI=0 VN=3 Mode=3)
    packet = bytearray(48)
    packet[0] = 0x1B
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
            sock.settimeout(timeout)
            sock.sendto(packet, (host, 123))
            data, _ = sock.recvfrom(128)
            latency = (time.monotonic() - started) * 1000
            if len(data) < 48:
                return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="ntp", reachable=False, error="resposta NTP inválida")
            # Transmit timestamp starts at byte 40
            seconds = struct.unpack("!I", data[40:44])[0]
            # NTP epoch -> Unix
            unix_ts = seconds - 2208988800 if seconds > 2208988800 else seconds
            return ProtocolProbeResult(
                protocol="ntp",
                reachable=True,
                latency_ms=round(latency, 2),
                detail="NTP OK",
                metrics={"server_unix_ts": float(unix_ts)},
            )
    except OSError as exc:
        return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="ntp", reachable=False, error=str(exc)[:120])


def probe_modbus(host: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> ProtocolProbeResult:
    """Modbus TCP — Function 3 (Read Holding Registers) unit 1, address 0, qty 1."""
    timeout = timeout or settings.protocol_probe_timeout_seconds
    # MBAP + PDU
    transaction_id = 1
    protocol_id = 0
    length = 6
    unit_id = 1
    function = 3
    start_addr = 0
    quantity = 1
    request = struct.pack(
        "!HHHBBHH",
        transaction_id,
        protocol_id,
        length,
        unit_id,
        function,
        start_addr,
        quantity,
    )
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with socket.create_connection((host, 502), timeout=timeout) as sock:
            sock.settimeout(timeout)
            sock.sendall(request)
            data = sock.recv(64)
            latency = (time.monotonic() - started) * 1000
            if len(data) < 9:
                return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="modbus", reachable=False, error="resposta curta")
            # Exception responses have function | 0x80
            func = data[7]
            if func & 0x80:
                return ProtocolProbeResult(
                    protocol="modbus",
                    reachable=True,
                    latency_ms=round(latency, 2),
                    detail=f"exception code {data[8] if len(data) > 8 else '?'}",
                )
            return ProtocolProbeResult(
                protocol="modbus",
                reachable=True,
                latency_ms=round(latency, 2),
                detail="Modbus TCP OK",
                metrics={"byte_count": float(data[8]) if len(data) > 8 else 0.0},
            )
    except OSError as exc:
        return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="modbus", reachable=False, error=str(exc)[:120])


def probe_mqtt(host: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> ProtocolProbeResult:
    """MQTT 3.1.1 CONNECT + espera CONNACK (sem auth)."""
    timeout = timeout or settings.protocol_probe_timeout_seconds
    # Fixed header CONNECT + remaining length + variable header + payload (client id)
    client_id = b"sentinelai"
    # Variable header: protocol name MQTT, level 4, flags 0, keepalive 60
    var_header = b"\x00\x04MQTT\x04\x00\x00\x3c"
    payload = struct.pack("!H", len(client_id)) + client_id
    remaining = var_header + payload
    # Remaining length encoding (single byte for small packets)
    packet = bytes([0x10, len(remaining)]) + remaining
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with socket.create_connection((host, 1883), timeout=timeout) as sock:
            sock.settimeout(timeout)
            sock.sendall(packet)
            data = sock.recv(8)
            latency = (time.monotonic() - started) * 1000
            if len(data) >= 4 and data[0] == 0x20:
                return_code = data[3]
                ok = return_code == 0
                return ProtocolProbeResult(
                    protocol="mqtt",
                    reachable=True,
                    latency_ms=round(latency, 2),
                    detail="CONNACK accepted" if ok else f"CONNACK rc={return_code}",
                    metrics={"connack": float(return_code)},
                )
            return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="mqtt", reachable=False, error="CONNACK inválido")
    except OSError as exc:
        return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="mqtt", reachable=False, error=str(exc)[:120])


def probe_ipmi(host: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> ProtocolProbeResult:
    """IPMI RMCP ping (UDP 623) — reachability / BMC presence."""
    timeout = timeout or settings.protocol_probe_timeout_seconds
    # RMCP ASF Presence Ping
    # Version=6, reserved=0, seq=0xFF, class=ASF(0x06), message type Presence Ping (0x80)
    packet = bytes(
        [
            0x06,
            0x00,
            0xFF,
            0x06,  # RMCP header
            0x00,
            0x00,
            0x11,
            0xBE,  # IANA Enterprise Number (ASF)
            0x80,  # Message Type: Presence Ping
            0x00,  # Message Tag
            0x00,
            0x00,  # Reserved
            0x00,
            0x00,
            0x00,
            0x00,  # Data length + padding
        ]
    )
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        with socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) as sock:
            sock.settimeout(timeout)
            sock.sendto(packet, (host, 623))
            data, _ = sock.recvfrom(128)
            latency = (time.monotonic() - started) * 1000
            return ProtocolProbeResult(
                protocol="ipmi",
                reachable=True,
                latency_ms=round(latency, 2),
                detail=f"RMCP reply {len(data)} bytes",
            )
    except OSError as exc:
        return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="ipmi", reachable=False, error=str(exc)[:120])


def probe_winrm(host: str, timeout: float | None = None) -> ProtocolProbeResult:
    """WinRM — probe HTTP(S) /wsman nas portas 5985/5986 (+ NTLM opcional)."""
    timeout = timeout or settings.protocol_probe_timeout_seconds
    import httpx

    endpoints = [
        f"http://{host}:5985/wsman",
        f"https://{host}:5986/wsman",
    ]
    username = settings.winrm_username or settings.wmi_username
    password = settings.winrm_password or settings.wmi_password

    for url in endpoints:
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            with httpx.Client(timeout=timeout, verify=False) as client:
                # OPTIONS/POST sem auth: WinRM tipicamente responde 401 se serviço ativo
                response = client.post(
                    url,
                    content="",
                    headers={"Content-Type": "application/soap+xml;charset=UTF-8"},
                )
                latency = (time.monotonic() - started) * 1000
                if response.status_code in (200, 401, 405):
                    authenticated = False
                    if username and password and response.status_code == 401:
                        try:
                            from requests_ntlm import HttpNtlmAuth  # type: ignore
                        except ImportError:
                            HttpNtlmAuth = None  # noqa: N806
                        if HttpNtlmAuth is None:
                            # Tentativa básica via httpx Digest/Basic não cobre NTLM;
                            # marca serviço presente.
                            authenticated = False
                        else:
                            authenticated = False
                    return ProtocolProbeResult(
                        protocol="winrm",
                        reachable=True,
                        latency_ms=round(latency, 2),
                        detail=f"HTTP {response.status_code} · {url}",
                        metrics={"http_status": float(response.status_code), "authenticated": 1.0 if authenticated else 0.0},
                    )
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.debug("WinRM probe %s failed: %s", url, exc)
            continue

    # Fallback: port open
    tcp = _tcp_probe(host, 5985, timeout=timeout)
    if tcp.reachable:
        return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="winrm", reachable=True, latency_ms=tcp.latency_ms, detail="porta 5985 aberta")
    tcp6 = _tcp_probe(host, 5986, timeout=timeout)
    if tcp6.reachable:
        return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="winrm", reachable=True, latency_ms=tcp6.latency_ms, detail="porta 5986 aberta")
    return ProtocolProbeResult(protocol="winrm", reachable=False, error=tcp.error or "WinRM inacessível")


def probe_all_protocols(host: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
    probes = {
        "winrm": probe_winrm,
        "modbus": probe_modbus,
        "mqtt": probe_mqtt,
        "ipmi": probe_ipmi,
        "telnet": probe_telnet,
        "ntp": probe_ntp,
    }
    results: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for name, fn in probes.items():
        try:
            results[name] = fn(host).to_dict()
        except Exception as exc:
            results[name] = ProtocolProbeResult(protocol=name, reachable=False, error=str(exc)[:120]).to_dict()
    return results

"""Enriquecimento AD / identidade (LDAP + atributos WMI)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import logging
import re

from ldap3 import ALL, SUBTREE, Connection, Server
from ldap3.core.exceptions import LDAPException

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass
class AdIdentityInfo:
    display_name: str | None = None
    sam_account: str | None = None
    user_principal: str | None = None
    ou: str | None = None
    department: str | None = None
    title: str | None = None
    email: str | None = None
    dn: str | None = None
    computer_dn: str | None = None
    computer_ou: str | None = None
    error: str | None = None

    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
        return {
            "display_name": self.display_name,
            "sam_account": self.sam_account,
            "user_principal": self.user_principal,
            "ou": self.ou,
            "department": self.department,
            "title": self.title,
            "email": self.email,
            "dn": self.dn,
            "computer_dn": self.computer_dn,
            "computer_ou": self.computer_ou,
            "error": self.error,
        }


def _extract_ou(dn: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not dn:
        return None
    parts = [p for p in dn.split(",") if p.upper().startswith("OU=")]
    if not parts:
        return None
    return ",".join(p[3:] for p in parts)


def _ldap_connection() -> Connection | None:
    if not settings.ldap_enabled or not settings.ldap_server:
        return None
    if not settings.ldap_bind_dn:
        return None
    server = Server(
        settings.ldap_server,
        port=settings.ldap_port,
        use_ssl=settings.ldap_use_ssl,
        get_info=ALL,
    )
    return Connection(server, user=settings.ldap_bind_dn, password=settings.ldap_bind_password, auto_bind=True)


def lookup_ad_user(username: str) -> AdIdentityInfo:
    info = AdIdentityInfo(sam_account=username)
    if not username:
        info.error = "username vazio"
        return info
    try:
        conn = _ldap_connection()
        if not conn:
            info.error = "LDAP não configurado"
            return info
        search_filter = settings.ldap_user_search_filter.format(username=username)
        attrs = [
            "displayName",
            "cn",
            "sAMAccountName",
            "userPrincipalName",
            "department",
            "title",
            "mail",
            "distinguishedName",
        ]
        conn.search(settings.ldap_base_dn, search_filter, search_scope=SUBTREE, attributes=attrs)
        if not conn.entries:
            info.error = "utilizador não encontrado no AD"
            conn.unbind()
            return info
        entry = conn.entries[0]
        info.dn = entry.entry_dn
        info.ou = _extract_ou(entry.entry_dn)
        info.display_name = str(entry.displayName) if "displayName" in entry and entry.displayName else (
            str(entry.cn) if "cn" in entry else None
        )
        info.sam_account = str(entry.sAMAccountName) if "sAMAccountName" in entry else username
        info.user_principal = str(entry.userPrincipalName) if "userPrincipalName" in entry else None
        info.department = str(entry.department) if "department" in entry and entry.department else None
        info.title = str(entry.title) if "title" in entry and entry.title else None
        info.email = str(entry.mail) if "mail" in entry and entry.mail else None
        conn.unbind()
        return info
    except LDAPException as exc:
        info.error = str(exc)[:200]
        logger.debug("AD user lookup failed: %s", exc)
        return info


def lookup_ad_computer(hostname: str) -> AdIdentityInfo:
    info = AdIdentityInfo()
    short = (hostname or "").split(".")[0]
    if not short:
        info.error = "hostname vazio"
        return info
    try:
        conn = _ldap_connection()
        if not conn:
            info.error = "LDAP não configurado"
            return info
        search_filter = f"(&(objectClass=computer)(sAMAccountName={short}$))"
        conn.search(
            settings.ldap_base_dn,
            search_filter,
            search_scope=SUBTREE,
            attributes=["cn", "dNSHostName", "distinguishedName", "operatingSystem", "department"],
        )
        if not conn.entries:
            # fallback por cn
            conn.search(
                settings.ldap_base_dn,
                f"(&(objectClass=computer)(cn={short}))",
                search_scope=SUBTREE,
                attributes=["cn", "dNSHostName", "distinguishedName", "operatingSystem", "department"],
            )
        if not conn.entries:
            info.error = "computador não encontrado no AD"
            conn.unbind()
            return info
        entry = conn.entries[0]
        info.computer_dn = entry.entry_dn
        info.computer_ou = _extract_ou(entry.entry_dn)
        info.ou = info.computer_ou
        info.department = str(entry.department) if "department" in entry and entry.department else None
        info.display_name = str(entry.cn) if "cn" in entry else short
        conn.unbind()
        return info
    except LDAPException as exc:
        info.error = str(exc)[:200]
        logger.debug("AD computer lookup failed: %s", exc)
        return info


def parse_ou_from_dn(dn: str | None) -> str | None:
    return _extract_ou(dn)


def normalize_windows_user(raw: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not raw:
        return None
    text = raw.strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    # DOMAIN\user or user@domain
    if "\\" in text:
        return text.split("\\", 1)[1]
    if "@" in text:
        return text.split("@", 1)[0]
    # SID-looking
    if re.fullmatch(r"S-\d(-\d+)+", text):
        return None
    return text

):
    from sqlalchemy import select

    from app.models import Device

    existing = await db.execute(select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == payload.ip_address))
    row = existing.scalar_one_or_none()

    if row and row.status == DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
        await update_device_field(db, row, "status", DeviceStatus.UNKNOWN)
        await update_device_field(db, row, "device_type", payload.device_type)
        if payload.hostname:
            await update_device_field(db, row, "hostname", payload.hostname)
        if payload.vendor:
            await update_device_field(db, row, "vendor", payload.vendor)
        if payload.model:

        if payload.mac_address:
            await update_device_field(db, row, "mac_address", payload.mac_address)
        if payload.tags:
            row.tags = payload.tags
        device = row
    elif row:
        if payload.device_type:
            await update_device_field(db, row, "device_type", payload.device_type)
        if payload.hostname:
            await update_device_field(db, row, "hostname", payload.hostname)
        if payload.vendor:
            await update_device_field(db, row, "vendor", payload.vendor)
        if payload.model:

        if payload.mac_address:

    layout_row = await db.execute(select(TopologyLayout).where(TopologyLayout.device_id == device.id))

    db.add(layout)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(device)

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from types import SimpleNamespace

from sqlalchemy import or_, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.engines.topology.neighbor_collector import NeighborInfo, collect_cdp_neighbors, collect_lldp_neighbors
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, LinkProtocol, LinkStatus, NetworkLink, TopologyGroup, TopologyLayout
from app.services.device_service import create_device_with_monitor_sync


def _resolve_device(session: Session, neighbor: NeighborInfo) -> Device | None:
    if neighbor.remote_ip:
        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == neighbor.remote_ip)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device

    if neighbor.remote_name:
        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(
                or_(
                    Device.hostname == neighbor.remote_name,
                    Device.hostname.ilike(neighbor.remote_name),
                )
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device

        device = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.hostname.ilike(f"%{neighbor.remote_name}%"))
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if device and device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return device
    return None


def register_neighbor_device(session: Session, neighbor: NeighborInfo) -> Device | None:
    if not neighbor.remote_ip:
        return None
    existing = session.execute(
        select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == neighbor.remote_ip)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        if existing.status == DeviceStatus.RETIRED:
            return None
        return existing
    return create_device_with_monitor_sync(
        session,
        ip_address=neighbor.remote_ip,
        hostname=neighbor.remote_name,
        device_type="network_device",
    )


def _upsert_link(
    session: Session,
    source: Device,
    neighbor: NeighborInfo,
    target: Device | None,
    edge_style: str = "smoothstep",
    map_layer: str = "physical",
) -> bool:
    protocol = LinkProtocol(neighbor.protocol) if neighbor.protocol != "manual" else LinkProtocol.MANUAL
    existing = session.execute(
        select(NetworkLink).where(
            NetworkLink.source_device_id == source.id,
            NetworkLink.source_port == neighbor.local_port,
            NetworkLink.remote_hostname == neighbor.remote_name,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()

    if existing:
        existing.target_device_id = target.id if target else existing.target_device_id
        existing.target_port = neighbor.remote_port
        existing.remote_ip = neighbor.remote_ip
        existing.protocol = protocol
        existing.status = LinkStatus.ACTIVE
        existing.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        session.add(existing)
        return False

    session.add(
        NetworkLink(
            source_device_id=source.id,
            target_device_id=target.id if target else None,
            source_port=neighbor.local_port,
            target_port=neighbor.remote_port,
            remote_hostname=neighbor.remote_name,
            remote_ip=neighbor.remote_ip,
            protocol=protocol,
            status=LinkStatus.ACTIVE,
            edge_style=edge_style,
            map_layer=map_layer,
        )
    )
    return True


def discover_topology_for_device(session: Session, device: Device, community: str | None = None) -> int:
    neighbors = collect_lldp_neighbors(device.ip_address, community)
    if not neighbors:
        neighbors = collect_cdp_neighbors(device.ip_address, community)

    created = 0
    for neighbor in neighbors:
        registered = register_neighbor_device(session, neighbor)
        target = registered or _resolve_device(session, neighbor)
        if _upsert_link(session, device, neighbor, target):
            created += 1
    return created


def _normalize_handles(
    source_handle: str | None,
    target_handle: str | None,
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    valid_source = {"right", "bottom"}
    valid_target = {"top", "left"}
    sh = source_handle if source_handle in valid_source else "right"
    th = target_handle if target_handle in valid_target else "left"
    return sh, th


def create_manual_link(
    session: Session,
    source_device_id: int,
    target_device_id: int,
    label: str | None = None,
    edge_style: str = "smoothstep",
    map_layer: str = "physical",
    source_handle: str | None = None,
    target_handle: str | None = None,
) -> NetworkLink:
    source = session.get(Device, source_device_id)
    target = session.get(Device, target_device_id)
    if not source or not target:
        raise ValueError("Dispositivo origem ou destino não encontrado")

    sh, th = _normalize_handles(source_handle, target_handle)

    existing_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            SELECT id FROM network_links
            WHERE map_layer = :layer AND lower(protocol::text) = 'manual'
              AND source_device_id = :src AND target_device_id = :tgt
            LIMIT 1
            """
        ),
        {"layer": map_layer, "src": source.id, "tgt": target.id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing_id:
        session.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE network_links
                SET source_handle = :sh, target_handle = :th, edge_style = :style
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"sh": sh, "th": th, "style": edge_style, "id": existing_id},
        )
        return SimpleNamespace(id=existing_id)

    reverse_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            SELECT id FROM network_links
            WHERE map_layer = :layer AND lower(protocol::text) = 'manual'
              AND source_device_id = :tgt AND target_device_id = :src
            LIMIT 1
            """
        ),
        {"layer": map_layer, "src": source.id, "tgt": target.id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if reverse_id:
        session.execute(
            text(
                """
                UPDATE network_links
                SET source_device_id = :src, target_device_id = :tgt,
                    source_handle = :sh, target_handle = :th, edge_style = :style
                WHERE id = :id
                """
            ),
            {"src": source.id, "tgt": target.id, "sh": sh, "th": th, "style": edge_style, "id": reverse_id},
        )
        return SimpleNamespace(id=reverse_id)

    link_id = session.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO network_links
                (source_device_id, target_device_id, source_port, protocol, status,
                 edge_style, map_layer, source_handle, target_handle)
            VALUES
                (:src, :tgt, :port, 'manual'::link_protocol, 'ACTIVE'::link_status,

        ),

            "layer": map_layer,
            "sh": sh,
            "th": th,
        },
    ).scalar_one()
    return SimpleNamespace(id=link_id)


def delete_manual_link(session: Session, link_id: int) -> None:
    deleted = session.execute(
        text(
            "DELETE FROM network_links WHERE id = :id AND lower(protocol::text) = 'manual' RETURNING id"
        ),
        {"id": link_id},
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if not deleted:
        raise ValueError("Link não encontrado")

from dataclasses import dataclass

from app.engines.discovery.snmp_collector import snmp_walk


@dataclass
class NeighborInfo:
    local_port: str | None
    remote_name: str | None
    remote_port: str | None
    remote_ip: str | None
    protocol: str


def collect_lldp_neighbors(host: str, community: str | None = None) -> list[NeighborInfo]:
    neighbors: list[NeighborInfo] = []

    sys_names = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.4.1.1.9", community, limit=64)
    port_ids = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.4.1.1.7", community, limit=64)
    port_descs = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.4.1.1.8", community, limit=64)
    local_ports = snmp_walk(host, "1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.3.7.1.3", community, limit=64)

    for index, remote_name in enumerate(sys_names):
        if not remote_name or remote_name in ("", "0"):
            continue
        neighbors.append(
            NeighborInfo(
                local_port=local_ports[index] if index < len(local_ports) else None,
                remote_name=remote_name,
                remote_port=port_descs[index] if index < len(port_descs) else port_ids[index] if index < len(port_ids) else None,
                remote_ip=None,
                protocol="lldp",
            )
        )
    return neighbors


def collect_cdp_neighbors(host: str, community: str | None = None) -> list[NeighborInfo]:
    neighbors: list[NeighborInfo] = []

    device_ids = snmp_walk(host, "1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.23.1.2.1.1.6", community, limit=64)
    device_ports = snmp_walk(host, "1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.23.1.2.1.1.7", community, limit=64)
    local_ports = snmp_walk(host, "1.3.6.1.4.1.9.9.23.1.2.1.1.1", community, limit=64)

    for index, remote_name in enumerate(device_ids):
        if not remote_name:
            continue
        neighbors.append(
            NeighborInfo(
                local_port=local_ports[index] if index < len(local_ports) else None,
                remote_name=remote_name,
                remote_port=device_ports[index] if index < len(device_ports) else None,
                remote_ip=None,
                protocol="cdp",
            )
        )
    return neighbors

import io
import os
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from reportlab.lib import colors
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4, landscape
from reportlab.lib.units import mm
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import settings
from app.services.topology_service import build_topology_graph


def export_topology_pdf(session: Session, map_layer: str | None = None) -> str:
    os.makedirs(settings.reports_output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    filename = f"topology_{datetime.now(UTC).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.pdf"
    path = os.path.join(settings.reports_output_dir, filename)

    graph = build_topology_graph(session, map_layer=map_layer)
    width, height = landscape(A4)
    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=landscape(A4))
    c.setTitle("SentinelAI — Mapa de Rede")

    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 16)
    c.drawString(20 * mm, height - 15 * mm, "SentinelAI — Mapa de Topologia")
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 10)
    c.drawString(20 * mm, height - 22 * mm, f"Gerado em {datetime.now(UTC).strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')} · {len(graph['nodes'])} nós · {len(graph['edges'])} links")

    scale = 0.15
    offset_x = 30 * mm
    offset_y = 40 * mm

    for node in graph["nodes"]:
        x = offset_x + node["position"]["x"] * scale
        y = height - offset_y - node["position"]["y"] * scale
        status = node.get("status", "unknown")
        fill = colors.green if status == "active" else colors.red if status == "inactive" else colors.grey
        c.setFillColor(fill)
        c.circle(x, y, 4 * mm, fill=1, stroke=0)
        c.setFillColor(colors.black)
        c.setFont("Helvetica", 7)
        c.drawString(x + 5 * mm, y, node.get("label", "")[:30])

    c.setStrokeColor(colors.HexColor("#64748b"))
    c.setLineWidth(0.5)
    node_pos = {n["id"]: n["position"] for n in graph["nodes"]}
    for edge in graph["edges"]:
        src = node_pos.get(edge["source"])
        tgt = node_pos.get(edge["target"])
        if not src or not tgt:
            continue
        x1 = offset_x + src["x"] * scale
        y1 = height - offset_y - src["y"] * scale
        x2 = offset_x + tgt["x"] * scale
        y2 = height - offset_y - tgt["y"] * scale
        c.line(x1, y1, x2, y2)

    c.showPage()
    c.save()
    return path

import os
import zipfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from xml.sax.saxutils import escape

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import settings
from app.services.topology_service import build_topology_graph


def _shape_xml(shape_id: int, pin_x: float, pin_y: float, width: float, height: float, label: str, fill: str) -> str:
    return f"""
    <Shape ID="{shape_id}" Type="Shape" LineStyle="3" FillStyle="3" TextStyle="3">
      <Cell N="PinX" V="{pin_x:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="PinY" V="{pin_y:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="Width" V="{width:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="Height" V="{height:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="FillForegnd" V="{fill}"/>
      <Text>{escape(label)}</Text>
    </Shape>"""


def _connector_xml(shape_id: int, x1: float, y1: float, x2: float, y2: float) -> str:
    return f"""
    <Shape ID="{shape_id}" Type="Shape" LineStyle="3" FillStyle="3" TextStyle="3">
      <Cell N="PinX" V="{(x1 + x2) / 2:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="PinY" V="{(y1 + y2) / 2:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="Width" V="{abs(x2 - x1):.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="Height" V="{abs(y2 - y1):.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="BeginX" V="{x1:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="BeginY" V="{y1:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="EndX" V="{x2:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="EndY" V="{y2:.4f}"/>
      <Cell N="ShapeRouteStyle" V="16"/>
    </Shape>"""


def export_topology_vsdx(session: Session, map_layer: str | None = None) -> str:
    os.makedirs(settings.reports_output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    filename = f"topology_{datetime.now(UTC).strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.vsdx"
    path = os.path.join(settings.reports_output_dir, filename)

    graph = build_topology_graph(session, map_layer=map_layer)
    device_nodes = [n for n in graph["nodes"] if not n.get("is_group")]

    xs = [n["position"]["x"] for n in device_nodes] or [0]
    ys = [n["position"]["y"] for n in device_nodes] or [0]
    min_x, max_x = min(xs), max(xs)
    min_y, max_y = min(ys), max(ys)
    span_x = max(max_x - min_x, 1)
    span_y = max(max_y - min_y, 1)

    page_w = 11.0
    page_h = 8.5
    pos_map: dict[str, tuple[float, float]] = {}
    shapes_xml: list[str] = []
    shape_id = 2

    status_colors = {"active": "#22c55e", "inactive": "#ef4444", "unknown": "#94a3b8"}

    for node in device_nodes:
        nx = page_w * 0.1 + ((node["position"]["x"] - min_x) / span_x) * page_w * 0.8
        ny = page_h * 0.9 - ((node["position"]["y"] - min_y) / span_y) * page_h * 0.8
        pos_map[node["id"]] = (nx, ny)
        fill = status_colors.get(node.get("status", "unknown"), "#94a3b8")
        label = f"{node.get('label', '')}\n{node.get('ip_address') or ''}"
        shapes_xml.append(_shape_xml(shape_id, nx, ny, 1.2, 0.6, label.strip(), fill))
        shape_id += 1

    for edge in graph["edges"]:
        src = pos_map.get(edge["source"])
        tgt = pos_map.get(edge["target"])
        if not src or not tgt:
            continue
        shapes_xml.append(_connector_xml(shape_id, src[0], src[1], tgt[0], tgt[1]))

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select

from app.config import settings
from app.db_sync import SyncSession
from app.engines.scanner.port_scanner import COMMON_PORTS, scan_ports
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, DiscoveryJobStatus, PortScanJob
from app.services.inventory_service import merge_extra_data, record_device_change_sync
from app.services.topology_service import (
    build_topology_graph,
    discover_topology_for_device,
    infer_gateway_links,
)
from app.workers.celery_app import celery_app


@celery_app.task(name="app.workers.topology_tasks.run_topology_discovery")
def run_topology_discovery() -> dict:
    with SyncSession() as session:
        devices = session.execute(
            select(Device).where(Device.status.in_([DeviceStatus.ACTIVE, DeviceStatus.UNKNOWN]))
        ).scalars().all()

        links_created = 0
        for device in devices:
            try:
                links_created += discover_topology_for_device(session, device, settings.snmp_community)
            except Exception:
                continue

        inferred = infer_gateway_links(session)
        session.commit()

    return {"links_created": links_created, "inferred": inferred}


@celery_app.task(name="app.workers.topology_tasks.run_port_scan")
def run_port_scan(job_id: int) -> dict:
    import asyncio

    with SyncSession() as session:
        job = session.get(PortScanJob, job_id)
        if not job:
            return {"error": "job not found"}

        device = session.get(Device, job.device_id)
        if not device:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = "Dispositivo não encontrado"
            session.commit()
            return {"error": "device not found"}

        job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.RUNNING
        job.started_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        job.ports_total = len(COMMON_PORTS)
        session.commit()

        try:
            open_ports = asyncio.run(scan_ports(device.ip_address))
            results = [
                {
                    "port": port.port,
                    "open": port.open,
                    "service": port.service,
                    "banner": port.banner,
                }
                for port in open_ports
            ]

            job.results = results
            job.ports_open = len(results)
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.COMPLETED
            job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)

            merged = merge_extra_data(device.extra_data, {"open_ports": results})
            if merged != (device.extra_data or {}):
                old_str = str(device.extra_data)
                device.extra_data = merged
                record_device_change_sync(session, device.id, "extra_data", old_str, str(merged))

            device.last_scan_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            session.add(device)
            session.commit()
            return {"job_id": job_id, "ports_open": job.ports_open}
        except Exception as exc:
            job.status = DiscoveryJobStatus.FAILED
            job.error_message = str(exc)
            job.completed_at = datetime.now(UTC)
            session.commit()
            raise

import aiosmtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


async def send_email_alert(subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
    if not settings.smtp_host or not settings.alert_email_to:
        logger.info("Email não configurado. Alerta: %s - %s", subject, body)
        return False

    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = settings.smtp_from
    message["To"] = settings.alert_email_to
    message["Subject"] = subject
    message.set_content(body)

    try:
        await aiosmtplib.send(
            message,
            hostname=settings.smtp_host,
            port=settings.smtp_port,
            username=settings.smtp_user or None,
            password=settings.smtp_password or None,
            start_tls=True,
        )
        return True
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("Falha ao enviar email: %s", exc)
        return False

import logging

import httpx

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def sms_configured() -> bool:
    return bool(
        settings.twilio_account_sid
        and settings.twilio_auth_token
        and settings.twilio_from_number
        and settings.alert_sms_to
    )


async def send_sms_alert(subject: str, body: str) -> bool:
    if not sms_configured():
        logger.info("SMS não configurado. Alerta: %s - %s", subject, body)
        return False

    text = f"{subject}\n\n{body}"[:1600]
    url = f"https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{settings.twilio_account_sid}/Messages.json"
    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=15) as client:
            response = await client.post(
                url,
                auth=(settings.twilio_account_sid, settings.twilio_auth_token),
                data={
                    "From": settings.twilio_from_number,
                    "To": settings.alert_sms_to,
                    "Body": text,
                },
            )
            if response.status_code in (200, 201):
                return True
            logger.error("Twilio SMS failed (%s): %s", response.status_code, response.text[:500])
            return False
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.error("SMS alert failed: %s", exc)
        return False
