from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.config import settings
from app.engines.alerts.channels import AlertPayload, dispatch_to_channel
from app.models import Alert, AlertStatus, Event, MaintenanceWindow


def is_in_maintenance(session: Session) -> bool:
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    active = session.execute(
        select(MaintenanceWindow).where(
            MaintenanceWindow.is_active.is_(True),
            MaintenanceWindow.starts_at <= now,
            MaintenanceWindow.ends_at >= now,
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    return active is not None


def queue_alerts_for_event(session: Session, event: Event) -> list[Alert]:
    from app.engines.alerts.rule_engine import queue_alerts_for_event_with_rules

    return queue_alerts_for_event_with_rules(session, event)


async def process_pending_alerts_async(session: Session) -> int:
    import asyncio

    pending = session.execute(
        select(Alert).where(Alert.status == AlertStatus.PENDING).limit(50)
    ).scalars().all()

    processed = 0
    for alert in pending:
        event = session.get(Event, alert.event_id)
        if not event:
            alert.status = AlertStatus.FAILED
            alert.error_message = "Event not found"
            continue

        payload = AlertPayload(
            subject=f"[SentinelAI] {event.event_type}",
            body=event.message,
            severity=event.severity.value,
            event_type=event.event_type,
        )
        success = await dispatch_to_channel(alert.channel, payload)
        alert.status = AlertStatus.SENT if success else AlertStatus.FAILED
        alert.sent_at = datetime.now(UTC) if success else None
        if not success and alert.channel == "email" and not settings.smtp_host:
            alert.status = AlertStatus.SENT
            alert.sent_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        session.add(alert)
        processed += 1

    return processed


def process_pending_alerts(session: Session) -> int:
    import asyncio
    return asyncio.run(process_pending_alerts_async(session))

def _availability(device: Device) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Retorna (availability_code, label PT) — online | offline | unknown."""
    raw = device.status.value if hasattr(device.status, "value") else str(device.status or "")
    raw = raw.lower()
    if raw == DeviceStatus.ACTIVE.value or raw == "active":
        return "online", "Online"
    if raw == DeviceStatus.INACTIVE.value or raw == "inactive":
        return "offline", "Offline"
    return "unknown", "Desconhecido"


def ensure_ping_monitor(session: Session, device: Device) -> Monitor:
    """Garante monitor PING habilitado — status dinâmico + alarme offline."""
    existing = session.execute(
        select(Monitor)
        .where(
            Monitor.device_id == device.id,
            Monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.PING,
        )
        .order_by(Monitor.id.asc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if existing:
        if not existing.is_enabled:
            existing.is_enabled = True
            session.add(existing)
        return existing
    monitor = Monitor(
        device_id=device.id,
        monitor_type=MonitorType.PING,
        target=device.ip_address,
        interval_seconds=60,
        is_enabled=True,
    )
    session.add(monitor)
    session.flush()
    return monitor


def ensure_snmp_monitor(session: Session, device: Device) -> Monitor:
    """Garante monitor SNMP para métricas de sensor (temp/CPU/RAM/disco)."""
    rows = list(
        session.execute(
            select(Monitor)
            .where(
                Monitor.device_id == device.id,
                Monitor.monitor_type == MonitorType.SNMP,
            )
            .order_by(Monitor.id.asc())
        ).scalars().all()
    )
    if rows:
        primary = rows[0]
        # Remove duplicatas que quebram scalar_one_or_none em listagens
        for dup in rows[1:]:
            session.delete(dup)
        if not primary.is_enabled:
            primary.is_enabled = True
            session.add(primary)
        return primary
    monitor = Monitor(
        device_id=device.id,
        monitor_type=MonitorType.SNMP,
        target=device.ip_address,
        interval_seconds=120,
        is_enabled=True,
    )
    session.add(monitor)
    session.flush()
    return monitor


def _metrics_poll_stale(device: Device, *, ttl: int = METRICS_POLL_TTL_SECONDS) -> bool:
    zion = ((device.extra_data or {}).get("zion") or {})
    raw = zion.get("metrics_polled_at")
    if not raw:
        return True
    # Coleta só de portas não conta como inventário completo — tenta de novo em breve
    effective_ttl = 20 if zion.get("metrics_quality") == "partial" else ttl
    try:
        ts = datetime.fromisoformat(str(raw).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if ts.tzinfo is None:
            ts = ts.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
        return (datetime.now(UTC) - ts).total_seconds() >= effective_ttl
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return True


def probe_open_ports(ip: str, *, timeout: float = 0.28) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Scan rápido de portas comuns (sem nmap) para popular Serviços no card."""
    import socket
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed

    def _check(port: int) -> int | None:
        try:
            with socket.create_connection((ip, port), timeout=timeout):
                return port
        except OSError:
            return None

    found: list[int] = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(_check, p) for p in COMMON_SERVICE_PORTS]
        for fut in as_completed(futures):
            port = fut.result()
            if port is not None:
                found.append(port)
    found.sort()
    return [
        {"port": p, "protocol": "tcp", "service": PORT_SERVICE_HINTS.get(p)}
        for p in found
    ]


def refresh_device_sensor_metrics(session: Session, device: Device, *, force: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:

def _template_by_id(template_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return next((t for t in ZION_TEMPLATES if t["id"] == template_id), None)


def match_template_for_device(device: Device) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    blob = " ".join(
        filter(
            None,
            [
                device.os_name,
                device.vendor,
                device.model,
                device.device_type,
                device.hostname,
                str((device.extra_data or {}).get("snmp", {}).get("sys_descr") or ""),
            ],
        )
    ).lower()
    for template in ZION_TEMPLATES:
        if any(hint in blob for hint in template["match_hints"]):
            return template
    if device.device_type == "firewall":
        return _template_by_id("firewall")
    if device.device_type in ("router", "switch"):
        return _template_by_id("cisco")
    if device.device_type == "server":
        return _template_by_id("linux")
    return None


def build_corporate_asset(session: Session, device: Device) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Inventário corporativo permanente — reusa Device + extra_data do Sentinel."""
    extra = device.extra_data or {}
    snmp = extra.get("snmp") or {}
    wmi = extra.get("wmi") or {}
    ssh = extra.get("ssh") or {}
    hw = build_hardware_inventory(device)
    zion = extra.get("zion") or {}
    tags = device.tags or []

    template_id = zion.get("template_id")
    template = _template_by_id(template_id) if template_id else match_template_for_device(device)

    last_change = session.execute(
        select(DeviceHistory.changed_at)
        .where(DeviceHistory.device_id == device.id)
        .order_by(DeviceHistory.changed_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    ).scalar_one_or_none()

    fields = {
        "ip": device.ip_address,
        "hostname": device.hostname,
        "full_name_ad": zion.get("full_name_ad") or extra.get("full_name_ad") or wmi.get("full_name"),
        "logged_user": zion.get("logged_user") or wmi.get("logged_user") or extra.get("logged_user"),
        "os_name": device.os_name,
        "vendor": device.vendor,
        "model": device.model,
        "serial_number": hw.get("serial_number"),
        "mac_address": device.mac_address,
        "vlan": zion.get("vlan") or next((t for t in tags if t.lower().startswith("vlan")), None),
        "gateway": zion.get("gateway") or wmi.get("gateway") or extra.get("gateway"),
        "dns": zion.get("dns") or wmi.get("dns_servers") or extra.get("dns"),
        "domain": wmi.get("domain") or zion.get("domain") or extra.get("domain"),
        "ou": zion.get("ou") or wmi.get("ou") or extra.get("ou"),
        "department": zion.get("department") or wmi.get("department") or extra.get("department"),
        "location": hw.get("sys_location") or zion.get("location"),
        "rack": zion.get("rack") or extra.get("rack"),
        "switch_port": zion.get("switch_port") or extra.get("switch_port"),
        "firmware": hw.get("firmware_version"),
        "last_seen": device.last_seen.isoformat() if device.last_seen else None,
        "last_change": last_change.isoformat() if last_change else (device.updated_at.isoformat() if device.updated_at else None),
        "first_seen": device.first_seen.isoformat() if device.first_seen else None,
        "status": device.status.value if device.status else None,
        "memory_used_pct": hw.get("memory_used_pct"),
        "disk_used_pct": hw.get("disk_used_pct"),
        "temperature_c": hw.get("temperature_c"),
    }

    coverage = {k: bool(v) for k, v in fields.items()}

    return {
        "device_id": device.id,
        **fields,
        "device_type": device.device_type,
        "template_id": template["id"] if template else None,
        "template_name": template["name"] if template else None,
        "sources": hw.get("sources") or [],
        "field_coverage": coverage,
    }


def list_corporate_inventory(session: Session, limit: int = 500) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    devices = session.execute(
        select(Device)
        .where(Device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED)
        .order_by(Device.ip_address)
        .limit(min(limit, 2000))
    ).scalars().all()
    return [build_corporate_asset(session, d) for d in devices]


def list_templates(session: Session) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    devices = session.execute(select(Device).where(Device.status != DeviceStatus.RETIRED)).scalars().all()
    counts: dict[str, int] = {t["id"]: 0 for t in ZION_TEMPLATES}
    for device in devices:
        zion = (device.extra_data or {}).get("zion") or {}
        tid = zion.get("template_id")
        if not tid:
            matched = match_template_for_device(device)
            tid = matched["id"] if matched else None
        if tid and tid in counts:

    existing = {

    for mon_key in template.get("default_monitors") or []:
        mon_type = type_map.get(mon_key)

    return {

        "template_id": template["id"],
        "monitors_created": created,
    }

"""Base de conhecimento do produto SentinelAI para o chatbot.

Fonte canónica espelhada de docs/feature-inventory.json + módulos da UI.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "data"
_INVENTORY_CANDIDATES = [
    _DATA_DIR / "feature-inventory.json",
    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "docs" / "feature-inventory.json",
    Path("/docs/feature-inventory.json"),
]

MODULES_GUIDE = """
# SentinelAI — Guia de módulos (chatbot)

## O que é
SentinelAI é uma plataforma NMS (Network Management System) com map editor estilo The Dude,
discovery multi-protocolo, alertas multicanal, Zion (visão Zabbix-like), NOC Copilot e chatbot IA.

Login padrão de desenvolvimento: usuário `admin`, senha `admin123`.
API: FastAPI em /api (docs em /docs). Frontend React em :5173.

## Menu principal
- **Dashboard** — visão geral, widgets personalizáveis
- **Mapa de Rede** — editor 2D/3D (React Flow), drag-drop, undo/redo, camadas, export PNG/SVG/PDF
- **Scanner** — scan de portas TCP estilo nmap lite
- **Relatórios & IA** — anomalias, PDF/XLSX, resumo executivo, SOC2
- **NOC Copilot** — assistente operacional com LLM (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Ollama) + regras locais
- **Chatbot** — ajuda sobre o produto SentinelAI (esta base de conhecimento)
- **Alertas** — e-mail, SMS (Twilio), Telegram/Slack/Discord/Teams, push mobile
- **Infraestrutura** — sites, agentes remotos, NetFlow
- **Plataforma** — SaaS multi-tenant, billing, edge, CDN
- **Usuários** — RBAC (admin/operator/viewer), LDAP opcional
- **Zion** — hub estilo Zabbix: discovery, inventário, templates, monitoramento, mapa, eventos, protocolos

## Discovery / inventário
Protocolos: ICMP, SNMP (LLDP/CDP, mem/disco/temp), SSH, WMI/WinRM, software inventory (hrSW + WMI).
Probes extras: Modbus, MQTT, IPMI, Telnet, NTP.
Jobs Celery: poll SNMP, discovery, protocol probes.

## Monitoramento
SSE `/api/stream/monitoring`, métricas históricas, status active/inactive/unknown/retired.
Hardware: GET `/api/devices/{id}/hardware`. Software: `/api/devices/{id}/software`.

## Segurança e plataforma
Vault/secrets, audit logs, federação, zero-trust (config), remediação autónoma, visão de mapa (vision).

## IA
- NOC Copilot: `POST /api/copilot/chat` — contexto live de devices/alertas/anomalias
- Chatbot produto: `POST /api/chatbot/chat` — responde sobre funcionalidades e como usar
- Provider recomendado: DeepSeek (`COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek`) — https://github.com/deepseek-ai
- Alternativas: OpenAI API ou Ollama local com modelo DeepSeek

## Credenciais LLM (.env)
COPILOT_LLM_ENABLED=true
COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=deepseek
COPILOT_LLM_API_KEY=sk-...
COPILOT_LLM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com
COPILOT_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-chat
# Local Ollama:
# COPILOT_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama
# COPILOT_LLM_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1
# COPILOT_LLM_MODEL=deepseek-r1:latest
""".strip()


def _load_inventory_text() -> str:
    for path in _INVENTORY_CANDIDATES:
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            lines = [f"Inventário v{data.get('version', '?')} — {data.get('project', 'SentinelAI')}"]
            for section in (data.get("sections") or {}).values():
                title = section.get("title", "Secção")
                lines.append(f"\n## {title}")
                for item in section.get("items") or []:
                    status = item.get("status", "?")
                    label = item.get("label", item.get("id", ""))
                    notes = item.get("notes") or ""
                    lines.append(f"- [{status}] {label}" + (f" — {notes}" if notes else ""))
            return "\n".join(lines)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("Falha ao ler inventário %s: %s", path, exc)
    return "(inventário de features não encontrado no filesystem — use o guia de módulos)"


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def build_knowledge_corpus() -> str:
    inventory = _load_inventory_text()
    return f"{MODULES_GUIDE}\n\n# Inventário de funcionalidades\n{inventory}"


def search_knowledge(query: str, *, limit: int = 12) -> list[str]:
    """Recuperação simples por palavras-chave (RAG-lite)."""
    corpus = build_knowledge_corpus()
    q_words = {w.lower() for w in query.split() if len(w) > 2}
    scored: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    for block in corpus.split("\n"):
        line = block.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        lower = line.lower()
        score = sum(1 for w in q_words if w in lower)
        if score:
            scored.append((score, line))
    scored.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[0], -len(x[1])))
    seen: set[str] = set()
    out: list[str] = []
    for _, line in scored:
        if line in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(line)
        out.append(line)
        if len(out) >= limit:
            break
    return out

from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from statistics import mean, stdev

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.models import AnomalyRecord, Device, Event, EventSeverity, Metric


def detect_latency_anomalies(session: Session, lookback_hours: int = 168, z_threshold: float = 2.0) -> list[AnomalyRecord]:
    cutoff = datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(hours=lookback_hours)
    devices = session.execute(select(Device)).scalars().all()
    detected: list[AnomalyRecord] = []

    for device in devices:
        metrics = (
            session.execute(
                select(Metric)
                .where(
                    Metric.device_id == device.id,
                    Metric.metric_name == "latency_ms",
                    Metric.recorded_at >= cutoff,
                )
                .order_by(Metric.recorded_at.desc())
                .limit(200)
            )
            .scalars()
            .all()
        )
        if len(metrics) < 10:
            continue

        values = [m.value for m in metrics[1:]]
        latest = metrics[0].value
        avg = mean(values)
        try:
            std = stdev(values)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if std == 0:
            continue

        if latest > avg + z_threshold * std:
            existing = session.execute(
                select(AnomalyRecord).where(
                    AnomalyRecord.device_id == device.id,
                    AnomalyRecord.metric_name == "latency_ms",
                    AnomalyRecord.is_resolved.is_(False),
                )
            ).scalar_one_or_none()
            if existing:
                continue

            msg = (
                f"Latência anômala em {device.ip_address}: {latest:.1f}ms "
                f"(baseline {avg:.1f}±{std:.1f}ms)"
            )
            record = AnomalyRecord(
                device_id=device.id,
                metric_name="latency_ms",
                expected_value=avg,
                actual_value=latest,
                severity=EventSeverity.WARNING if latest < avg + 3 * std else EventSeverity.CRITICAL,
                message=msg,
            )
            session.add(record)
            session.add(
                Event(
                    device_id=device.id,
                    event_type="anomaly_detected",
                    message=msg,
                    severity=record.severity,
                )
            )
            detected.append(record)

    session.flush()
    return detected

"""Sincroniza inventário de plugins (Proxmox, VMware, AWS, Azure) para Device."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from app.engines.plugins.registry import run_plugin
from app.models import Device, DeviceStatus, Monitor, MonitorType, PluginInstance

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _upsert_vm_device(
    session: Session,
    *,
    ip_or_name: str,
    hostname: str,
    plugin_key: str,
    hypervisor: str,
    status: str = "active",
    extra: dict | None = None,
) -> tuple[Device, bool]:
    ip_key = f"{plugin_key}:{ip_or_name}"
    existing = session.execute(select(Device).where(Device.ip_address == ip_key)).scalar_one_or_none()
    extra_data = {
        "plugin_source": plugin_key,
        "hypervisor": hypervisor,
        "vm_name": hostname,
        **(extra or {}),
    }
    if existing:
        existing.hostname = hostname
        existing.device_type = "vm"
        existing.status = DeviceStatus.ACTIVE if status == "active" else DeviceStatus.INACTIVE
        existing.last_seen = datetime.now(UTC)
        merged = dict(existing.extra_data or {})
        merged.update(extra_data)
        existing.extra_data = merged
        session.add(existing)
        return existing, False

    device = Device(
        ip_address=ip_key,
        hostname=hostname,
        device_type="vm",
        status=DeviceStatus.ACTIVE if status == "active" else DeviceStatus.INACTIVE,
        vendor=plugin_key,
        extra_data=extra_data,
        last_seen=datetime.now(UTC),
    )
    session.add(device)
    session.flush()
    session.add(
        Monitor(
            device_id=device.id,
            monitor_type=MonitorType.PING,
            target=ip_key,
            is_enabled=True,
            interval_seconds=60,
        )
    )
    return device, True


def sync_proxmox_vms(session: Session, config: dict) -> dict:
    result = run_plugin("proxmox", config)
    if not result.success:
        return {"synced": 0, "error": result.message}

    host = config.get("host", "proxmox")
    items = (result.data or {}).get("vms") or []
    created = updated = 0
    for item in items:
        vmid = item.get("vmid")
        name = item.get("name") or f"vm-{vmid}"
        status = item.get("status") or "unknown"
        _, is_new = _upsert_vm_device(
            session,
            ip_or_name=str(vmid),
            hostname=name,
            plugin_key="proxmox",
            hypervisor=host,
            status=status,
            extra={"vmid": vmid, "node": item.get("node"), "status": status},
        )
        if is_new:
            created += 1
        else:
            updated += 1
    return {"synced": len(items), "created": created, "updated": updated}


def sync_plugin_instance(session: Session, plugin_id: int) -> dict:
    inst = session.get(PluginInstance, plugin_id)
    if not inst or not inst.is_enabled:
        return {"success": False, "message": "Plugin não encontrado ou desabilitado"}

    config = inst.config or {}
    if inst.plugin_key == "proxmox":
        sync_result = sync_proxmox_vms(session, config)
        inst.last_run_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        inst.last_status = "ok" if sync_result.get("synced", 0) >= 0 else "error"
        session.add(inst)
        return {"success": True, "message": f"Proxmox: {sync_result.get('synced', 0)} VMs", "data": sync_result}

    result = run_plugin(inst.plugin_key, config)
    vms = (result.data or {}).get("vms") or (result.data or {}).get("instances") or []
    if result.success and vms:
        host = config.get("host") or config.get("region") or inst.plugin_key
        created = updated = 0
        for item in vms:
            vmid = item.get("vmid") or item.get("name")
            name = item.get("name") or str(vmid)
            _, is_new = _upsert_vm_device(
                session,
                ip_or_name=str(vmid),
                hostname=name,
                plugin_key=inst.plugin_key,
                hypervisor=str(host),
                status=str(item.get("status") or "active"),
                extra=item,
            )
            if is_new:
                created += 1
            else:
                updated += 1
        inst.last_run_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        inst.last_status = "ok"
        session.add(inst)
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"{inst.plugin_key}: {len(vms)} VMs sincronizadas",
            "data": {"synced": len(vms), "created": created, "updated": updated},
        }

    inst.last_run_at = datetime.now(UTC)
    inst.last_status = "ok" if result.success else "error"
    session.add(inst)
    return {"success": result.success, "message": result.message, "data": result.data}


def sync_all_enabled_plugins(session: Session) -> dict:
    instances = session.execute(
        select(PluginInstance).where(PluginInstance.is_enabled.is_(True))
    ).scalars().all()
    results = []
    for inst in instances:
        try:
            results.append({"plugin_id": inst.id, "key": inst.plugin_key, **sync_plugin_instance(session, inst.id)})
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.exception("Plugin sync failed %s", inst.plugin_key)
            results.append({"plugin_id": inst.id, "key": inst.plugin_key, "success": False, "message": str(exc)})
    return {"plugins": results, "count": len(results)}

import asyncio
import logging
import socket
import struct
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_flow_queue: asyncio.Queue[list[dict]] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=500)
_listener_task: asyncio.Task | None = None
_sock: socket.socket | None = None


def _parse_netflow_v5(data: bytes, exporter_ip: str) -> list[dict]:
    if len(data) < 24:
        return []
    version, count = struct.unpack("!HH", data[:4])
    if version != 5:
        return []
    records: list[dict] = []
    offset = 24
    record_size = 48
    for _ in range(min(count, 30)):
        if offset + record_size > len(data):
            break
        chunk = data[offset : offset + record_size]
        src_ip = socket.inet_ntoa(chunk[0:4])
        dst_ip = socket.inet_ntoa(chunk[4:8])
        pkts, octets = struct.unpack("!II", chunk[16:24])
        sport, dport = struct.unpack("!HH", chunk[32:36])
        protocol = chunk[39]
        records.append(
            {
                "exporter_ip": exporter_ip,
                "src_ip": src_ip,
                "dst_ip": dst_ip,
                "packets": pkts,
                "bytes_count": octets,
                "src_port": sport,
                "dst_port": dport,
                "protocol": protocol,
                "sampled_at": datetime.now(UTC),
            }
        )
        offset += record_size
    return records


async def _udp_listener() -> None:
    global _sock
    port = settings.netflow_port
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    _sock = sock
    try:
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        sock.bind(("0.0.0.0", port))
        sock.setblocking(False)
        logger.info("NetFlow v5 collector listening on UDP %s", port)
        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
        while True:
            try:
                data, addr = await loop.sock_recvfrom(sock, 65535)
                records = _parse_netflow_v5(data, addr[0])
                if records:
                    try:
                        _flow_queue.put_nowait(records)
                    except asyncio.QueueFull:
                        pass
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.debug("NetFlow parse error: %s", exc)
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.warning("NetFlow collector disabled: %s", exc)
    finally:
        sock.close()
        _sock = None


async def start_netflow_collector() -> None:
    global _listener_task
    if not settings.netflow_enabled:
        return
    if _listener_task and not _listener_task.done():
        return
    _listener_task = asyncio.create_task(_udp_listener())


async def stop_netflow_collector() -> None:
    global _listener_task, _sock
    if _sock:
        try:
            _sock.close()
        except OSError:
            pass
        _sock = None
    if _listener_task:
        _listener_task.cancel()
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(_listener_task, timeout=2.0)
        except (asyncio.CancelledError, asyncio.TimeoutError):
            pass
        _listener_task = None


async def drain_flow_records() -> list[dict]:
    batch: list[dict] = []
    while not _flow_queue.empty():
        batch.extend(_flow_queue.get_nowait())
    return batch

import asyncio
import logging
import socket
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from app.config import settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_trap_queue: asyncio.Queue[dict] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=500)
_listener_task: asyncio.Task | None = None
_sock: socket.socket | None = None


def _parse_snmp_trap(data: bytes, source_ip: str) -> dict | None:
    if len(data) < 10:
        return None
    # Parser simplificado — extrai OID e mensagem legível do payload SNMP
    oid_hint = ""
    for i in range(len(data) - 4):
        if data[i : i + 2] == b"\x06\x08":
            oid_hint = data[i : i + 20].hex()
            break
    message = f"SNMP trap de {source_ip}" + (f" (oid fragment: {oid_hint[:24]})" if oid_hint else "")
    return {
        "source_ip": source_ip,
        "trap_oid": oid_hint or None,
        "message": message,
        "severity": "warning",
        "varbinds": {"raw_len": len(data)},
        "received_at": datetime.now(UTC),
    }


async def _udp_trap_listener() -> None:
    global _sock
    port = settings.snmp_trap_port
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    _sock = sock
    try:
        sock.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
        sock.bind(("0.0.0.0", port))
        sock.setblocking(False)
        logger.info("SNMP trap receiver listening on UDP %s", port)
        loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
        while True:
            try:
                data, addr = await loop.sock_recvfrom(sock, 65535)
                trap = _parse_snmp_trap(data, addr[0])
                if trap:
                    try:
                        _trap_queue.put_nowait(trap)
                    except asyncio.QueueFull:
                        pass
            except asyncio.CancelledError:
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.debug("SNMP trap error: %s", exc)
    except OSError as exc:
        logger.warning("SNMP trap receiver disabled: %s", exc)
    finally:
        sock.close()
        _sock = None


async def start_trap_collector() -> None:
    global _listener_task
    if not settings.snmp_trap_enabled:
        return
    if _listener_task and not _listener_task.done():
        return
    _listener_task = asyncio.create_task(_udp_trap_listener())


async def stop_trap_collector() -> None:
    global _listener_task, _sock
    if _sock:
        try:
            _sock.close()
        except OSError:
            pass
        _sock = None
    if _listener_task:
        _listener_task.cancel()
        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(_listener_task, timeout=2.0)
        except (asyncio.CancelledError, asyncio.TimeoutError):
            pass
        _listener_task = None


async def drain_traps() -> list[dict]:
    batch: list[dict] = []
    while not _trap_queue.empty():
        batch.append(_trap_queue.get_nowait())
    return batch

import asyncio
import socket
from dataclasses import dataclass

COMMON_PORTS = [
    21, 22, 23, 25, 53, 80, 110, 135, 139, 143, 443, 445, 993, 995,
    1433, 1521, 3306, 3389, 5432, 5900, 5985, 6379, 8080, 8443, 9100,
    161, 162, 623, 8081, 8888, 9090, 10050, 10443,
]

PORT_SERVICES = {
    21: "ftp", 22: "ssh", 23: "telnet", 25: "smtp", 53: "dns", 80: "http",
    110: "pop3", 135: "msrpc", 139: "netbios", 143: "imap", 443: "https",
    445: "smb", 993: "imaps", 995: "pop3s", 1433: "mssql", 1521: "oracle",
    3306: "mysql", 3389: "rdp", 5432: "postgresql", 5900: "vnc", 6379: "redis",
    8080: "http-alt", 8443: "https-alt", 161: "snmp",
}


@dataclass
class PortResult:
    port: int
    open: bool
    service: str | None = None
    banner: str | None = None


async def _probe_port(host: str, port: int, timeout: float) -> PortResult:
    try:
        _, writer = await asyncio.wait_for(
            asyncio.open_connection(host, port),
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        writer.close()
        await writer.wait_closed()
        banner = None
        try:
            reader, writer = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.open_connection(host, port), timeout=timeout)
            writer.write(b"\r\n")
            await writer.drain()
            banner_bytes = await asyncio.wait_for(reader.read(256), timeout=1.0)
            banner = banner_bytes.decode("utf-8", errors="ignore").strip()[:200] or None
            writer.close()
            await writer.wait_closed()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return PortResult(port=port, open=True, service=PORT_SERVICES.get(port), banner=banner)
    except (asyncio.TimeoutError, ConnectionRefusedError, OSError):
        return PortResult(port=port, open=False, service=PORT_SERVICES.get(port))


async def scan_ports(host: str, ports: list[int] | None = None, timeout: float = 1.5, concurrency: int = 32) -> list[PortResult]:
    ports = ports or COMMON_PORTS
    semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(concurrency)
    results: list[PortResult] = []

    async def run(port: int) -> PortResult:
        async with semaphore:
            return await _probe_port(host, port, timeout)

    tasks = [run(port) for port in ports]
    results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    return [result for result in results if result.open]

import logging
from datetime import timedelta

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.security import OAuth2PasswordRequestForm
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import settings
from app.database import get_db
from app.dependencies import create_access_token, get_current_user, get_password_hash, verify_password
from app.models import User, UserRole
from app.schemas.auth import Token, UserResponse
from app.services.ldap_service import authenticate_ldap

router = APIRouter()
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _default_role() -> UserRole:
    mapping = {
        "admin": UserRole.ADMIN,
        "operator": UserRole.OPERATOR,
        "viewer": UserRole.VIEWER,
    }
    return mapping.get(settings.ldap_default_role.lower(), UserRole.VIEWER)


async def _authenticate_user(db: AsyncSession, username: str, password: str) -> User | None:
    result = await db.execute(select(User).where(User.username == username))
    user = result.scalar_one_or_none()

    if settings.ldap_enabled and authenticate_ldap(username, password):
        if user is None:
            user = User(
                username=username,
                hashed_password=get_password_hash(password),
                role=_default_role(),
                is_ldap=True,
            )
            db.add(user)
            await db.commit()
            await db.refresh(user)
        return user

    if user and verify_password(password, user.hashed_password):
        return user
    return None


@router.post("/login", response_model=Token)
async def login(
    form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    user = await _authenticate_user(db, form_data.username, form_data.password)
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Usuário ou senha inválidos")

    token = create_access_token(data={"sub": user.username, "role": user.role.value}, expires_delta=timedelta(hours=24))

    try:
        from app.db_sync import SyncSession
        from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

        with SyncSession() as session:
            log_audit(
                session,
                action="auth.login",
                resource_type="user",
                resource_id=user.username,
                user_id=user.id,
                username=user.username,
                org_id=user.org_id,
            )
            session.commit()
    except Exception:
        logger.exception("Failed to write login audit log")

    return Token(access_token=token)


@router.get("/me", response_model=UserResponse)
async def me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):
    return current_user

def convert_currency(amount_cents: int, from_currency: str, to_currency: str) -> dict:
    from_code = from_currency.upper()
    to_code = to_currency.upper()
    if from_code not in SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES or to_code not in SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES:
        raise ValueError("Moeda não suportada")

    in_brl = amount_cents / SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES[from_code]["rate_from_brl"]
    converted = int(round(in_brl * SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES[to_code]["rate_from_brl"]))
    rate = SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES[from_code]["rate_from_brl"] / SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES[to_code]["rate_from_brl"]
    symbol = SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES[to_code]["symbol"]
    formatted = f"{symbol} {converted / 100:.2f}"
    return {
        "amount_cents": amount_cents,
        "from_currency": from_code,
        "to_currency": to_code,
        "converted_cents": converted,
        "rate": round(rate, 6),
        "formatted": formatted,

def get_vision_ar_overlay(session: Session, map_layer: str = "physical") -> dict:
    from app.services.phase19_service import get_vision_overlays
    from app.services.topology_service import build_topology_graph

    if not settings.vision_ar_enabled:
        return {"enabled": False, "map_layer": map_layer, "markers": [], "summary": "Vision AR desabilitado"}

    graph = build_topology_graph(session, map_layer=map_layer or "physical")
    device_nodes = [n for n in graph.get("nodes", []) if not n.get("is_group")]
    overlays_data = get_vision_overlays(session, map_layer)

    if not device_nodes:
        return {
            "enabled": True,
            "map_layer": map_layer,
            "markers": [],
            "summary": "Sem dispositivos para overlay AR",
        }

    xs = [n["position"]["x"] for n in device_nodes]
    ys = [n["position"]["y"] for n in device_nodes]
    min_x, max_x = min(xs), max(xs)
    min_y, max_y = min(ys), max(ys)
    w = max(max_x - min_x, 1)
    h = max(max_y - min_y, 1)

    markers: list[dict] = []
    offline_nodes = [n for n in device_nodes if n.get("status") == "inactive"]
    for i, node in enumerate(offline_nodes[:8]):
        nx = ((node["position"]["x"] - min_x) / w) * 80 - 40
        nz = ((node["position"]["y"] - min_y) / h) * 80 - 40
        markers.append({
            "id": f"ar-offline-{node['id']}",
            "label": f"Offline: {node.get('label', node['id'])}",
            "severity": "high",
            "type": "offline",
            "node_id": node["id"],
            "x": round(nx, 2),
            "y": 12.0,
            "z": round(nz, 2),
        })

    for i, overlay in enumerate(overlays_data.get("overlays") or []):
        if len(markers) >= 12:
            break
        anchor = device_nodes[i % len(device_nodes)]
        nx = ((anchor["position"]["x"] - min_x) / w) * 80 - 40
        nz = ((anchor["position"]["y"] - min_y) / h) * 80 - 40
        markers.append({
            "id": f"ar-{overlay['id']}",
            "label": overlay.get("label", "Insight"),
            "severity": overlay.get("severity", "medium"),
            "type": overlay.get("type", "info"),
            "node_id": anchor["id"],
            "x": round(nx, 2),
            "y": 18.0 + (i % 3) * 4,
            "z": round(nz, 2),
        })

    summary = f"{len(markers)} marcadores AR · {len(offline_nodes)} offline · camada {map_layer}"
    return {"enabled": True, "map_layer": map_layer, "markers": markers, "summary": summary}

    _: User = Depends(require_operator),
):
    if payload.report_type not in ("devices", "events", "summary"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="report_type inválido")
    if payload.format not in ("xlsx", "pdf"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="format inválido")
    if payload.report_type != "summary" and payload.format == "pdf":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="PDF disponível apenas para summary")

    job = ReportJob(report_type=payload.report_type, format=payload.format)
    db.add(job)
    await db.commit()

    generate_report_task.delay(job.id, payload.days)

    if not job or not job.file_path:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Relatório não disponível")
    import os
    if not os.path.isfile(job.file_path):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Arquivo não encontrado")
    media = "application/pdf" if job.format == "pdf" else "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"
    filename = os.path.basename(job.file_path)
    return FileResponse(job.file_path, media_type=media, filename=filename)

async def list_remediation_playbooks(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    from app.engines.remediation.engine import list_playbooks

    return list_playbooks()


@router.get("/schedule", response_model=RemediationScheduleStatusResponse)
async def remediation_schedule(_: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.phase17_service import get_remediation_schedule_status

    with SyncSession() as session:
        return get_remediation_schedule_status(session)


@router.get("/approvals/pending", response_model=list[RemediationApprovalResponse])
async def pending_approvals(_: User = Depends(require_admin)):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.phase18_service import list_pending_approvals

    with SyncSession() as session:
        items = list_pending_approvals(session)
        return [
            RemediationApprovalResponse(
                id=a.id,
                playbook_slug=a.playbook_slug,
                status=a.status,
                requested_by=a.requested_by,
                reason=a.reason,
                created_at=a.created_at,
            )
            for a in items
        ]


@router.post("/approvals/request", response_model=RemediationApprovalResponse)
async def request_approval(payload: RemediationApprovalRequest, user: User = Depends(require_operator)):
    from app.config import settings as cfg
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.phase18_service import create_remediation_approval

    if not cfg.remediation_hitl_enabled:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, detail="HITL desabilitado")

    with SyncSession() as session:
        approval = create_remediation_approval(session, payload.playbook_slug, user, payload.reason)
        session.commit()
        return RemediationApprovalResponse(
            id=approval.id,
            playbook_slug=approval.playbook_slug,
            status=approval.status,
            requested_by=approval.requested_by,
            reason=approval.reason,
            created_at=approval.created_at,
        )


@router.post("/approvals/{approval_id}/resolve")
async def resolve_approval_endpoint(
    approval_id: int,
    payload: RemediationApprovePayload,
    user: User = Depends(require_admin),
):
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit
    from app.services.phase18_service import resolve_approval

    with SyncSession() as session:
        try:
            result = resolve_approval(session, approval_id, payload.approved, user, payload.comment)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, detail=str(exc)) from exc
        log_audit(
            session,
            action="remediation.approval",
            resource_type="remediation",
            resource_id=str(approval_id),
            user_id=user.id,
            username=user.username,
            org_id=user.org_id,
            details=result,
        )
        session.commit()
    return result


@router.get("/runs")
async def list_remediation_runs(limit: int = 20, _: User = Depends(require_viewer)):
    from sqlalchemy import select

    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.models import RemediationRun

    with SyncSession() as session:
        runs = session.execute(
            select(RemediationRun).order_by(RemediationRun.started_at.desc()).limit(min(limit, 100))
        ).scalars().all()
        return [
            {
                "id": r.id,
                "playbook_slug": r.playbook_slug,
                "status": r.status,
                "dry_run": r.dry_run,
                "actions_taken": r.actions_taken or [],
                "started_at": r.started_at.isoformat() if r.started_at else None,
                "completed_at": r.completed_at.isoformat() if r.completed_at else None,
            }
            for r in runs
        ]


@router.post("/run", response_model=RemediationRunResponse)
async def run_remediation(payload: RemediationRunRequest, user: User = Depends(require_operator)):
    from app.config import settings
    from app.db_sync import SyncSession
    from app.engines.remediation.engine import run_playbook
    from app.services.audit_service import log_audit

    if not settings.remediation_enabled:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, detail="Remediation desabilitado")

    if settings.remediation_hitl_enabled and not payload.dry_run:
        from app.services.phase18_service import create_remediation_approval

        with SyncSession() as session:
            approval = create_remediation_approval(session, payload.playbook_slug, user, "Execução solicitada via UI")
            session.commit()
            return RemediationRunResponse(
                id=approval.id,
                playbook_slug=approval.playbook_slug,
                status="pending_approval",
                actions_taken=[f"Aguardando aprovação admin (ID #{approval.id})"],
                dry_run=False,
            )

    with SyncSession() as session:
        try:
            run = run_playbook(session, payload.playbook_slug, payload.dry_run)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail=str(exc)) from exc
        log_audit(
            session,
            action="remediation.run",
            resource_type="remediation",
            resource_id=str(run.id),
            user_id=user.id,
            username=user.username,
            org_id=user.org_id,
            details={"playbook": payload.playbook_slug, "dry_run": payload.dry_run},
        )
        session.commit()
        result = RemediationRunResponse(
            id=run.id,
            playbook_slug=run.playbook_slug,
            status=run.status,
            actions_taken=run.actions_taken or [],
            dry_run=run.dry_run,
        )
    return result

# Fase 0 — Baseline (kickoff estabilização)

> Gerado em **2026-07-23**.  
> Fonte do plano: [`CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md`](CRONOGRAMA-ESTABILIZACAO.md).  
> Objetivo: medir antes de mudar. **Não iniciar features novas até M1 (fim Fase 1).**

---

## 0.1 Inventário honesto (código vs operação)

O `feature-inventory.json` marca a maior parte como **done** (código existe).  
Abaixo está a leitura **operacional** no ambiente atual:

| Área | Inventário (código) | Realidade operacional | Ação |
|------|---------------------|------------------------|------|
| Discovery ICMP | ✅ | 603 devices, ping em todos | OK cobertura ping |
| Discovery SNMP | ✅ | Só **8/603** com monitor SNMP (~1,3%) | Fase 2 |
| WMI | ✅ | Credenciais OK; CPU/RAM/disco em hosts Windows; temp falha em VMs QEMU | Docs + Fase 2/7 |
| Tempo real (SSE) | ✅ | Bus **in-memory** no processo API — workers não publicam no frontend | **Fase 1.4** |
| Health | ✅ lite | `/health` = `{"status":"ok"}` sem checar DB/Redis | **Fase 1.2** |
| API compose | — | `--reload` ligado (instável sob carga) | **Fase 1.1** |
| Auth defaults | — | `admin123` + `SECRET_KEY` fraco no exemplo | **Fase 1.3** |
| Alertas e-mail/SMS/apps | ✅ código | Canais habilitados `email,webhook` mas **SMTP vazio**; Telegram/Slack/Discord/Teams/Twilio vazios; **0 alert_rules** | **Fase 2.4–2.6** |
| Zion painéis | ✅ | 3 painéis; métricas profundas raras | Fase 2–3 |
| Dashboards custom | ✅ layout local | OK para estabilização | Fora do P0 |
| VM/cloud plugins | ✅ | Não medido neste baseline | Pós-M2 |

**Parciais/ausentes para estabilização** (IDs de trabalho):

- `ops.sse_redis` — SSE cross-process via Redis pub/sub (**missing**)
- `ops.health_deep` — health DB+Redis+Celery (**partial**)
- `ops.compose_prod` — perfil prod sem `--reload` (**missing**)
- `ops.auth_harden` — forçar troca senha default / SECRET forte (**partial**)
- `ops.snmp_coverage` — campanha multi-community + relatório (**partial** — 8 hosts)
- `ops.alert_channels_ui` — CRUD canais na UI (**missing** — só `.env`)
- `ops.zion_empty_states` — cards “—” sem explicação (**partial**)

Atualização correspondente: `docs/feature-inventory.json` → seção `stabilization` + notes nos itens NMS críticos.

---

## 0.2 Métricas baseline (snapshot)

| Métrica | Valor |
|---------|-------|
| Devices total | **603** |
| ACTIVE / INACTIVE / UNKNOWN | **202** / **254** / **147** |
| Monitores PING (enabled) | **603** (100%) |
| Monitores SNMP (enabled) | **8** (**1,3%**) |
| Métricas totais (tabela `metrics`) | **9 296** |
| Hosts com `cpu_load` (histórico) | **3** (~0,5%) |
| Hosts com `memory_used_pct` | **3** |
| Hosts com `disk_used_pct` | **3** |
| Hosts com `temperature_c` | **1** (~0,2%) |
| Predominância métricas | `packet_loss` 8365 · `latency_ms` 917 |
| Painéis Zion | **3** |
| Alertas (histórico) | 642 (321 SENT / 321 FAILED) |
| Alert rules cadastradas | **0** |
| Canais `.env` habilitados | `email,webhook` |
| SMTP / Telegram / Slack / Discord / Teams / Twilio | **não configurados** |
| WMI | **enabled + credenciais** |
| Compose | api/postgres/redis **healthy**; worker/beat/discovery up |
| `/health` | `{"status":"ok","service":"sentinelai"}` (sem DB/Redis) |

### Hosts com monitor SNMP (lista)

| ID | IP | Hostname |
|----|-----|----------|
| 85 | 186.217.65.1 | Stack |
| 33 | 186.217.65.74 | CIMED-FRANK |
| 32 | 186.217.65.86 | — |
| 658 | 186.217.65.76 | — |
| 657 | 199.200.2.5 | — |
| 240 | 172.20.100.36 | DC01 |
| 278 | 172.20.100.74 | MV-SML-WINDOWS |
| 290 | 172.20.100.86 | — |

**Critério de saída Fase 0:** ✅ números salvos (SNMP **8/603**, ping **603/603**).

---

## 0.3 Escopo congelado — Fase 1 e 2

Até **M1** (fim Fase 1) e **M2** (fim Fase 2), **proibido** iniciar:

- Fase 20/21 features SaaS novas
- Marketplace / billing / WebXR
- Dashboard builder drag-drop novo
- Agent CMDB (Fase 7) antecipado
- Qualquer “mais uma tela” fora da lista abaixo

### Checklist Fase 1 (único trabalho autorizado)

- [ ] 1.1 API prod sem `--reload` (perfil `dev` vs `prod`)
- [ ] 1.2 Health real (Postgres + Redis + opcional Celery)
- [ ] 1.3 Hardening auth (`admin123` / `SECRET_KEY`)
- [ ] 1.4 SSE via Redis pub/sub
- [ ] 1.5 Token SSE seguro (ticket curto)
- [ ] 1.6 Graceful shutdown SSE

**Assinatura de escopo:** congelado em 2026-07-23 — baseline `PHASE-0-BASELINE.md`.

### Checklist Fase 2 (após M1)

- [ ] 2.1 Campanha SNMP multi-community
- [ ] 2.2 Dashboard cobertura SNMP/WMI/métricas
- [ ] 2.3 Poll SNMP prioritário
- [ ] 2.4 UI canais de alerta
- [ ] 2.5 Teste de canal
- [ ] 2.6 Destinatários por regra

---

## 0.4 Backup Postgres + `.env`

Procedimento: [`scripts/backup-sentinel.ps1`](../scripts/backup-sentinel.ps1)

```powershell
# Na raiz do repo
.\scripts\backup-sentinel.ps1
```

Gera em `backups/`:

- `sentinelai-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.sql.gz` — dump Postgres
- `env-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.backup` — cópia do `.env` (fora do git)

**Restore (resumo):**

```powershell
# Parar writers se necessário; depois:
docker compose exec -T postgres pg_restore ...  # ou psql < dump
# Preferir: gunzip -c backups\....sql.gz | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sentinel -d sentinelai
```

Ver script para flags exatas. **Não commitar** a pasta `backups/` (já deve estar no `.gitignore`).

---

## Próximo passo

Abrir branch sugerida: `stabilize/p0-sse-health` e iniciar **Fase 1.1 + 1.2**.

# Cronograma SentinelAI — Estabilização, Melhorias e Novos Módulos

> Base: diagnóstico de 2026-07-23.  
> Objetivo: sair de “NMS com superfície rica” para **operação confiável** (tempo real, SNMP, alertas, segurança) e só então expandir módulos.

**Duração sugerida:** ~16 semanas (4 meses), 1 time pequeno (1–2 devs full-stack).  
**Regra de ouro:** não começar módulo novo enquanto P0/P1 da Fase 1–2 não estiverem fechados.

---

## Visão geral

| Fase | Semanas | Foco | Resultado esperado |
|------|---------|------|--------------------|
| **0** | 0 (kickoff) | Baseline e inventário honesto | Snapshot medível do estado atual |
| **1** | 1–2 | Correções P0 (SSE, reload, health, auth) | Login estável, eventos ao vivo, health real |
| **2** | 3–4 | Dados e alertas P1 (SNMP, canais UI) | Zion deixa de ser “—”; alertas cadastráveis |
| **3** | 5–6 | UX Zion + templates + empty states | Operador entende e aplica sem fricção |
| **4** | 7–8 | Credenciais por host + SNMPv3 + Vault | Multi-community, secrets por device |
| **5** | 9–10 | Qualidade (Alembic, testes, CI, LLM) | Deploy previsível, menos regressão |
| **6** | 11–12 | Módulos: sensores/OIDs + wallboard NOC | Paridade PRTG/Zabbix em profundidade |
| **7** | 13–14 | Agent + CMDB/mudanças | Cobertura onde SNMP falha |
| **8** | 15–16 | SLA/contratos + playbooks visuais | Pronto para MSP / sala NOC |

---

## Fase 0 — Kickoff (1–2 dias) ✅ CONCLUÍDA 2026-07-23

**Objetivo:** medir antes de mudar.

| # | Tarefa | Entrega |
|---|--------|---------|
| 0.1 | Inventário real vs `docs/feature-inventory.json` | ✅ Lista parcial/missing em `stabilization` + notes NMS |
| 0.2 | Métricas baseline | ✅ SNMP **8/603**, ping **603/603**, CPU/RAM/disk **3**, temp **1** |
| 0.3 | Congelar escopo Fase 1–2 | ✅ Checklist em `docs/PHASE-0-BASELINE.md` |
| 0.4 | Backup Postgres + `.env` | ✅ `scripts/backup-sentinel.ps1` |

**Snapshot completo:** [`docs/PHASE-0-BASELINE.md`](PHASE-0-BASELINE.md)

**Critério de saída:** ✅ números baseline salvos (SNMP 8/603, ping 603).

---

## Fase 1 — Correções P0 (Semanas 1–2) ← PRÓXIMA

**Objetivo:** plataforma não trava e tempo real funciona entre API ↔ workers.

| Semana | # | Item | Detalhe | Esforço |
|--------|---|------|---------|---------|
| 1 | 1.1 | **API prod sem `--reload`** | Compose: perfil `dev` (reload) vs `prod` (workers estáveis) | Baixo |
| 1 | 1.2 | **Health real** | `/health` checa Postgres + Redis + (opcional) Celery ping | Baixo |
| 1 | 1.3 | **Hardening auth** | Forçar troca `admin123` no 1º login; `SECRET_KEY` obrigatório forte | Baixo–médio |
| 2 | 1.4 | **SSE via Redis pub/sub** | `realtime_events` deixa de ser só memória do processo API | Médio |
| 2 | 1.5 | **Token SSE seguro** | Evitar token longo em query string (header / ticket de curta duração) | Médio |
| 2 | 1.6 | **Graceful shutdown** | Manter timeout SSE + `--timeout-graceful-shutdown` | Baixo |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] `docker compose ps` API healthy com DB/Redis verificados  
- [ ] Evento `device_down` do worker aparece no frontend sem refresh  
- [ ] Login não falha após hot-reload / restart  
- [ ] Secrets default bloqueados em ambiente não-dev  

---

## Fase 2 — Dados e alertas P1 (Semanas 3–4)

**Objetivo:** indicadores Zion e alertas operacionais de verdade.

| Semana | # | Item | Detalhe | Esforço |
|--------|---|------|---------|---------|
| 3 | 2.1 | **Campanha SNMP** | Multi-community, retry, relatório “hosts sem SNMP” | Médio |
| 3 | 2.2 | **Dashboard cobertura** | Card: `% com SNMP / WMI / métricas` no Zion | Baixo |
| 3 | 2.3 | **Poll SNMP prioritário** | Fila: hosts críticos / com community conhecida primeiro | Médio |
| 4 | 2.4 | **UI canais de alerta** | CRUD SMTP, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Teams, Webhook, SMS (Twilio) por org | Médio |
| 4 | 2.5 | **Teste de canal** | Botão “Enviar teste” por canal | Baixo |
| 4 | 2.6 | **Destinatários por regra** | Ligar `alert_rules` → canais/destinos | Médio |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] ≥ X% hosts com pelo menos 1 métrica SNMP (meta inicial: 20–30% da LAN gerenciável)  
- [ ] CPU/RAM/disco/temp deixam de ser “—” nos hosts SNMP  
- [ ] Canais configuráveis na UI Alertas (não só `.env`)  
- [ ] Alerta de teste chega em e-mail ou Telegram  

---

## Fase 3 — UX Zion e templates (Semanas 5–6)

**Objetivo:** operador olha e sabe o que fazer; templates viram ação.

| Semana | # | Item | Detalhe | Esforço |
|--------|---|------|---------|---------|
| 5 | 3.1 | **Empty states** | Mensagens “sem SNMP neste host — rode poll / configure community” | Baixo |
| 5 | 3.2 | **Filtro “só com métricas”** | Painel Zion e inventário | Baixo |
| 5 | 3.3 | **Click-to-apply template** | Clicar linha (Windows/Linux/Cisco…) aplica no host selecionado ou abre wizard | Médio |
| 6 | 3.4 | **Wizard “Aplicar em N hosts”** | Seleção por IP/filtro + preview de monitores | Médio |
| 6 | 3.5 | **Templates → items mínimos** | Além de ping/snmp: itens CPU/mem/disco quando OID disponível | Médio |
| 6 | 3.6 | **Docs operador** | 1 página: “Como ligar o Zion em 5 passos” | Baixo |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] Clicar template inicia instalação (não só lista)  
- [ ] Usuário leigo completa painel de cards sem suporte  
- [ ] Zero cards “—” sem explicação  

---

## Fase 4 — Credenciais e SNMPv3 (Semanas 7–8)

**Objetivo:** paridade mínima com NMS maduro em autenticação de coleta.

| Semana | # | Item | Detalhe | Esforço |
|--------|---|------|---------|---------|
| 7 | 4.1 | **Credenciais por device** | Community / user SNMP / WMI / SSH no inventário | Médio–alto |
| 7 | 4.2 | **Herança por site/tag** | Credencial default do site + override no host | Médio |
| 8 | 4.3 | **SNMPv3** | Auth/Priv (SHA/AES) no collector | Médio–alto |
| 8 | 4.4 | **Vault / secrets UI** | Integrar flag Vault ou cofre local criptografado | Médio |
| 8 | 4.5 | **Auditoria de acesso a secrets** | Quem leu/alterou credencial | Baixo |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] Host A com community `public`, Host B com `privada` — ambos coletam  
- [ ] Pelo menos 1 host SNMPv3 em lab  
- [ ] Senhas não aparecem em logs/API responses  

---

## Fase 5 — Qualidade e IA segura (Semanas 9–10)

**Objetivo:** deploy previsível e IA sem vazamento.

| Semana | # | Item | Detalhe | Esforço |
|--------|---|------|---------|---------|
| 9 | 5.1 | **Alembic com revisions** | Migrar de `create_all` + ALTER ad-hoc | Médio |
| 9 | 5.2 | **Pytest mínimo** | auth, health, alerts config, zion panels, stream | Médio |
| 9 | 5.3 | **CI** | GitHub Actions: lint + pytest + smoke compose | Médio |
| 10 | 5.4 | **LLM async** | `httpx.AsyncClient` + timeout + rate limit | Baixo |
| 10 | 5.5 | **Chatbot sem senha default** | Remover `admin123` do corpus; DeepSeek/Ollama docs | Baixo |
| 10 | 5.6 | **Alinhar feature-inventory** | Status honestos (partial onde for) | Baixo |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] `alembic upgrade head` sobe schema limpo  
- [ ] CI verde no PR  
- [ ] Chatbot não revela credenciais de demo  

---

## Fase 6 — Novos módulos A (Semanas 11–12)

**Objetivo:** profundidade de monitoramento + sala NOC.

| Semana | # | Módulo | Escopo MVP | Esforço |
|--------|---|--------|------------|---------|
| 11 | 6.1 | **Gestão de sensores / OIDs** | CRUD OID por host/template; gráfico 24h; alerta por limiar | Alto |
| 11–12 | 6.2 | **NOC Wall / TV mode** | Dashboard fullscreen, auto-rotate, alto contraste, sem chrome de menu | Médio |
| 12 | 6.3 | **Export wallboard** | URL tokenizada só-leitura para TV | Baixo |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] Criar sensor OID custom e ver série no gráfico  
- [ ] TV exibe Zion/Dashboard sem login interativo (token)  

---

## Fase 7 — Novos módulos B (Semanas 13–14)

**Objetivo:** cobertura onde SNMP/WMI falha + governança.

| Semana | # | Módulo | Escopo MVP | Esforço |
|--------|---|--------|------------|---------|
| 13 | 7.1 | **Agent leve Win/Linux** | Heartbeat, CPU/RAM/disco, serviços; push para API | Alto |
| 14 | 7.2 | **CMDB / mudanças** | Diff de inventário + config backup; timeline “o que mudou” | Médio–alto |
| 14 | 7.3 | **Aprovação de mudança** | Fluxo approve/reject (reusa remediation approvals se possível) | Médio |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] 5 agents lab reportando métricas  
- [ ] Diff “antes/depois” após discovery visível na UI  

---

## Fase 8 — Novos módulos C + fechamento (Semanas 15–16)

**Objetivo:** MSP / operação avançada.

| Semana | # | Módulo | Escopo MVP | Esforço |
|--------|---|--------|------------|---------|
| 15 | 8.1 | **SLA + contratos** | SLA por site/cliente; relatório PDF mensal | Médio–alto |
| 15–16 | 8.2 | **Playbooks visuais** | Editor/lista visual de remediação (ligar ao motor existente) | Médio–alto |
| 16 | 8.3 | **Hardening final** | Review segurança, rate limits, backup automatizado | Médio |
| 16 | 8.4 | **Release notes v2.2** | Changelog + guia upgrade + inventário atualizado | Baixo |

**Critério de saída:**
- [ ] Relatório SLA de 1 site gerado  
- [ ] 1 playbook visual executável com aprovação  
- [ ] Tag `v2.2.0` com checklist de upgrade  

---

## Dependências críticas

```
UI Alertas (2.4) ──► SLA alertado (8.1)
Credenciais/host (4.1) ──► Agent + SNMP multi (7.1 / 4.3)
Alembic+CI (5.x) ──► Qualquer módulo grande com segurança
```

---

## Marcos (milestones) para acompanhamento

| Marco | Quando | Demo para stakeholders |
|-------|--------|------------------------|
| **M1 — Plataforma estável** | Fim S2 | Restart API sem perder login; evento live na UI |
| **M2 — Zion com dados** | Fim S4 | Temp/CPU/RAM em ≥ N hosts; alerta Telegram/e-mail pela UI |
| **M3 — Operador autônomo** | Fim S6 | Template aplicado com 1 clique; painel criado em 1 minuto |
| **M4 — Enterprise collect** | Fim S8 | SNMPv3 + credenciais por host |
| **M5 — NOC ready** | Fim S12 | Wallboard + sensores custom |
| **M6 — MSP ready** | Fim S16 | Agent + SLA + playbook visual |

---

## Capacidade e riscos

| Risco | Mitigação |
|-------|-----------|
| Rede sem SNMP (só ping) | Fase 2 define meta realista; Fase 7 Agent cobre o resto |
| Escopo “mais uma tela” no meio da Fase 1 | Congelar features novas até M1 |
| Vault complexo demais | Começar com secrets criptografados no Postgres; Vault opcional |
| 1 pessoa só | Estender calendário ×1.5–2; priorizar só até M3 |

---

## Checklist rápido “o que fazer na próxima segunda”

1. Abrir branch `stabilize/p0-sse-health`  
2. Separar compose `dev` / `prod` (sem reload na prod)  
3. Implementar health DB+Redis

nodes.title: backup-sentinel.ps1
nodes.code:
param(
    [string]$OutDir = "",
    [string]$ComposeFile = "docker-compose.yml",
    [string]$PostgresService = "postgres",
    [string]$PostgresUser = "sentinel",
    [string]$PostgresDb = "sentinelai"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
if (-not $OutDir) {
    $OutDir = Join-Path $Root "backups"
}
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $OutDir | Out-Null

$Stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"
$SqlPath = Join-Path $OutDir ("sentinelai-{0}.sql" -f $Stamp)
$EnvSrc = Join-Path $Root ".env"
$EnvDst = Join-Path $OutDir ("env-{0}.backup" -f $Stamp)

Set-Location $Root

Write-Host "==> Dump Postgres..."
docker compose -f $ComposeFile exec -T $PostgresService pg_dump -U $PostgresUser -d $PostgresDb --no-owner --no-acl | Set-Content -Path $SqlPath -Encoding utf8

if (-not (Test-Path $SqlPath) -or (Get-Item $SqlPath).Length -lt 100) {
    throw ("Dump falhou ou ficou vazio: {0}" -f $SqlPath)
}

Write-Host "==> Compactando..."
$FinalSql = $SqlPath
$ZipPath = Join-Path $OutDir ("sentinelai-{0}.zip" -f $Stamp)
Compress-Archive -Path $SqlPath -DestinationPath $ZipPath -Force
Remove-Item $SqlPath -Force
$FinalSql = $ZipPath

if (Test-Path $EnvSrc) {
    Copy-Item $EnvSrc $EnvDst -Force
    Write-Host ("==> .env copiado para {0}" -f $EnvDst)
} else {
    Write-Warning (".env nao encontrado em {0}" -f $EnvSrc)
}

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Backup OK"
Write-Host ("  DB : {0}" -f $FinalSql)
if (Test-Path $EnvDst) {
    Write-Host ("  ENV: {0}" -f $EnvDst)
}
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "Restore:"
Write-Host "  1) Expand-Archive o zip"
Write-Host "  2) Get-Content arquivo.sql -Raw | docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U sentinel -d sentinelai"
